证据位置：可训练参数减少约一万倍、显存需求降三倍的总体结论在摘要；训练显存从 1.2TB 降到 350GB、r=4 时 checkpoint 从 350GB 降到 35MB、训练提速 25% 都在 Section 4.2。
作者自陈局限：Section 4.2 明确以「LoRA also has its limitations」开头——如果把低秩矩阵合并进原权重以消除推理延迟，就无法在单次前向里为不同任务批量喂入不同的 A 与 B；作者给出的替代是延迟不敏感场景下不合并、按样本动态选模块。
它没主张的：论文没有说低秩适配能追上全参数微调的最终质量上限，也没有覆盖所有模型规模；被广泛转述的「省显存」是训练阶段的数字，不等于推理更快。
notes.en:
Problem: full fine-tuning of a large model requires storing every gradient and optimiser state, which is memory-expensive; can a low-rank increment be trained while the base weights stay frozen.
Where the evidence sits: the headline reduction of about ten thousand times fewer trainable parameters and three times less GPU memory is in the abstract; the drop from 1.2 TB to 350 GB of training VRAM, the checkpoint going from 350 GB to 35 MB at r=4, and a 25% training speed-up are all in Section 4.2.
What the authors say about limits: Section 4.2 opens with "LoRA also has its limitations" — if the low-rank matrices are merged into the original weights to remove inference latency, batched inputs to different tasks with different A and B in a single forward pass become awkward; the stated alternative is to skip the merge when latency is not critical and select modules per sample.
What it does not claim: the paper does not claim low-rank adaptation matches the quality ceiling of full fine-tuning, nor cover every model scale; the widely repeated memory saving is a training figure and does not imply faster inference.

title.zh: Hybrid Reasoning Agents
title.en: Hybrid Reasoning Agents

evidence.quote: dynamically navigate between latent reasoning and text-based interaction throughout a unified generation process
a lightweight HybridLink enables seamless transitions between text and latent modes
improves performance by 10.4%, while delivering 35.5%-54.7% token reduction, 1.8x-2.6x faster inference, and 2.7x-3.7x cost savings

notes.zh:
问题：文本推理可解释、能调工具，但 token 成本高；latent reasoning 省 token，却缺少原生工具访问与可读性；能不能在同一生成过程里在两种模式间动态切换。
证据位置：摘要提出 HybridAgents，用轻量 HybridLink 在文本与 latent 模式间切换，并用连续工作记忆跨多轮保留无损混合上下文；配套 HybridSFT 与 HybridRL 后训练；在 3 个模型规模、11 个基准（数学、科学、医学、搜索、智能体推理）上平均提升 10.4%，token 减 35.5–54.7%，推理快 1.8–2.6 倍，成本省 2.7–3.7 倍。
作者自陈局限：3 个模型规模、11 个基准；latent 模式可解释性仍有限；工具调用与多轮工作记忆依赖架构改造；没有生产部署与安全评估。
它没主张的：不是所有推理都该转 latent；不是 10.4% 是跨所有任务的统一增益；不是 token 减少必然保持同等可解释性。
notes.en:
Problem: text reasoning is inspectable and can call tools but costs tokens; latent reasoning saves tokens but lacks native tool access and readability; can a single generation process switch between the two.
Where the evidence sits: HybridAgents uses a lightweight HybridLink to switch between text and latent modes and keeps a continuous working memory across turns for lossless hybrid context; HybridSFT and HybridRL post-training coordinate the modes; across three model scales and 11 benchmarks in mathematics, science, medicine, search and agentic reasoning it improves performance by 10.4%, cuts tokens by 35.5–54.7%, speeds inference by 1.8–2.6× and saves 2.7–3.7× cost.
What the authors say about limits: three model scales and 11 benchmarks; latent-mode interpretability remains limited; tool use and multi-turn working memory require architectural changes; production deployment and safety evaluation are not covered.
What it does not claim: not that every reasoning task should move to latent space; not that 10.4% is a uniform gain across all tasks; not that token savings preserve the same interpretability.

specs.方法 / method: HybridLink + 连续工作记忆 + HybridSFT/HybridRL
specs.规模 / scale: 3 个模型规模，11 个基准

title.zh: Jamba: A Hybrid Transformer-Mamba Language Model
title.en: Jamba: A Hybrid Transformer-Mamba Language Model

evidence.quote: a new base large language model based on a novel hybrid Transformer-Mamba mixture-of-experts (MoE) architecture
a powerful model that fits in a single 80GB GPU
strong results for up to 256K tokens context length

notes.zh:
问题：纯 Transformer 的 KV cache 与长上下文成本高，纯 Mamba 又在部分离散任务上弱；能不能把 Transformer 与 Mamba 交错，再叠 MoE，同时保住吞吐与显存。
证据位置：摘要提出 Transformer 层与 Mamba 层交错的混合 MoE 架构，部分层加 MoE 提升容量；某个配置可放进单张 80GB GPU，在标准语言与长上下文评测上有竞争力，并给出 256K token 的结果；权重以宽松许可公开。
作者自陈局限：论文只实现并验证有限配置，层交错与专家混合方式依赖大量消融；256K 是特定评测，不是所有长上下文任务；没有独立复现与生产服务数据。
它没主张的：不是 Transformer 与 Mamba 的最优配比已定；不是单卡 80GB 就能训练同等模型；不是所有长上下文都优于纯 Transformer。
notes.en:
Problem: pure Transformers pay a large KV-cache and long-context cost, while pure Mamba can be weaker on some discrete tasks; can Transformer and Mamba layers be interleaved with MoE to keep throughput and memory.
Where the evidence sits: the abstract proposes a hybrid Transformer-Mamba MoE architecture with interleaved blocks and MoE in some layers; one configuration fits in a single 80GB GPU, is competitive on standard language and long-context evaluations and reports results up to 256K tokens; weights are released under a permissive licence.
What the authors say about limits: only a limited set of configurations is built and evaluated; interleaving and expert mixing depend on extensive ablations; 256K is a specific evaluation, not every long-context task; there is no independent reproduction or production serving data.
What it does not claim: not that the optimal Transformer/Mamba ratio is settled; not that one 80GB GPU can train an equivalent model; not that it beats pure Transformers on every long-context task.

title.zh: Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models
title.en: Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models

evidence.quote: The loss scales as a power-law with model size, dataset size, and the amount of compute used for training, with some trends spanning more than seven orders of magnitude.

Larger models are significantly more sample-efficient, such that optimally compute-efficient training involves training very large models on a relatively modest amount of data and stopping significantly before convergence.
Without a theory or a systematic understanding of the corrections to our scaling laws, it’s difficult to determine in what circumstances they can be trusted.
In the domain of natural language, it will be important to investigate whether continued improvement on the loss translates into improvement on relevant language tasks.

notes.zh:
问题：语言模型的交叉熵损失随参数量、数据量、训练算力怎么变，固定算力预算又该怎么分配，能不能写成可外推的公式。
证据位置：三条基本幂律在 §1.2 与 Figure 1（α_N≈0.076、α_D≈0.095、α_Cmin≈0.050），过拟合与数据/参数比例在 §4，算力最优分配在 §6.1 与 Figure 14（N(C_min)∝C_min^0.73，数据需求约按 C^0.27 增长）；局限有专门的 Appendix C Caveats，另有 §6.3 Contradictions and a Conjecture 与 §8 Discussion。
作者自陈局限：Appendix C 列了六条——目前对提出的任何标度律都没有扎实的理论理解，缺了理论或对修正项的系统认识就难以判断它们在什么情况下可信；对远超实验损失范围的 B_crit(L) 预测没有信心；小数据区没有仔细研究，最小 D 上 L(N,D) 拟合很差，也没试正则化与数据增强；算力用 C≈6NBS 估计、未计入与上下文长度成正比的项，因此在 n_ctx 很大时算力标度可能被混淆；可能漏调了某些影响标度的超参（如初始化尺度或动量）；学习率最优值依赖目标损失，未跑到收敛的短训练没有试过更高学习率。§6.3 还自己指出：外推到远高于实验的规模时 L(C_min) 与 L(D) 会相交而出现矛盾，说明幂律在那之前必然失效，交点是否代表性能上限只是作者的猜想。
它没主张的：论文测的是交叉熵损失，不是下游任务成绩——§8 明确把「损失继续下降是否转化为相关语言任务的提升」列为待研究；也没有说这些关系适用于语言以外，§8 写作者尚不知道哪些结果依赖自然语言数据的结构、哪些是普适的；「大模型配相对少量数据并显著早停」是给定算力预算下的分配结论，不是「数据不重要」的普遍主张，作者同时写明趋势最终必然变平，因为自然语言的熵非零。
notes.en:
Problem: how does language model cross-entropy loss change with parameter count, dataset size and training compute, how should a fixed compute budget be allocated, and can this be written as extrapolatable equations.
Where the evidence sits: the three basic power laws are in 1.2 and Figure 1 (alpha_N about 0.076, alpha_D about 0.095, alpha_Cmin about 0.050), overfitting and the data-to-parameter ratio in Section 4, and optimal compute allocation in 6.1 and Figure 14 (N(C_min) proportional to C_min^0.73, with data requirements growing roughly as C^0.27); the limits have a dedicated Appendix C Caveats, plus 6.3 Contradictions and a Conjecture and Section 8 Discussion.
What the authors say about limits: Appendix C lists six — there is at present no solid theoretical understanding of any of the proposed scaling laws, and without a theory or a systematic understanding of the corrections it is difficult to determine when they can be trusted; they are not especially confident in the B_crit(L) prediction far outside the explored loss range; the small data regime was not thoroughly investigated, fits for L(N,D) were poor at the smallest D, and regularisation and data augmentation were not tried; compute was estimated as C about 6NBS without the term proportional to context length, so compute scalings may be confounded at very large n_ctx; some hyperparameter affecting scaling (such as initialisation scale or momentum) may have been left untuned; and the optimal learning rate depends on the target loss, with higher rates not tried for runs that did not reach convergence. Section 6.3 also notes that extrapolating far beyond the studied scale makes L(C_min) and L(D) intersect, an apparent contradiction implying the laws must break down before that point, and whether the intersection marks maximal performance is offered only as a conjecture.
What it does not claim: the paper measures cross-entropy loss, not downstream task scores — Section 8 explicitly leaves open whether continued loss improvement translates into improvement on relevant language tasks; it does not claim the relations hold outside language, and Section 8 says the authors do not know which results depend on the structure of natural language data and which are universal; and very large models on relatively modest data with early stopping is an allocation result under a fixed compute budget, not a general claim that data does not matter — the authors also write that the trends must eventually level off because natural language has non-zero entropy.

specs.证据位置 / evidence: §1.2 与 Figure 1（三条幂律）；§4（过拟合）；§6.1 与 Figure 14（算力分配）；Appendix C Caveats；§6.3；§8
specs.趋势跨度 / span: 摘要称部分趋势跨越七个以上数量级
specs.测量对象 / metric: 交叉熵损失，不是下游任务分数
specs.算力分配结论 / allocation: 很大的模型 + 相对少量数据 + 显著早停（摘要口径）

title.zh: Kimi K2: Open Agentic Intelligence
title.en: Kimi K2: Open Agentic Intelligence

evidence.quote: a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) large language model with 32 billion activated parameters and 1 trillion total parameters
pre-trained on 15.5 trillion tokens with zero loss spike
K2 obtains 66.1 on Tau2-Bench, 76.5 on ACEBench (En), 65.8 on SWE-Bench Verified, and 47.3 on SWE-Bench Multilingual
all without extended thinking

notes.zh:
问题：开源模型在智能体任务上常落后于闭源模型；能不能用超大规模 MoE、稳定的优化器和智能体数据管线，把工具调用、软件工程与多语言能力做上去。
证据位置：摘要给出 1T 总参数、32B 激活的 MoE；提出 MuonClip 优化器，预训练 15.5T token 无 loss spike；后训练包含大规模智能体数据合成与联合 RL；在 Tau2-Bench 66.1、ACEBench 76.5、SWE-Bench Verified 65.8、SWE-Bench Multilingual 47.3，均为非 extended thinking 设置。
作者自陈局限：分数集中在非 thinking 设置与智能体/软件基准；没有展开通用对话、长程自主与安全评估；1T 总参数带来部署门槛；训练配方与数据只部分开放。
它没主张的：不是所有任务都超过闭源模型；不是 extended thinking 下同样领先；不是 32B 激活就等于消费级硬件可跑。
notes.en:
Problem: open models often trail closed models on agentic tasks; can a very large MoE, a stable optimizer and an agentic data pipeline improve tool use, software engineering and multilingual work.
Where the evidence sits: the abstract reports a 1T-total, 32B-activated MoE; the MuonClip optimizer enables 15.5T-token pre-training with zero loss spike; post-training includes large-scale agentic data synthesis and joint RL; scores are 66.1 on Tau2-Bench, 76.5 on ACEBench (En), 65.8 on SWE-Bench Verified and 47.3 on SWE-Bench Multilingual, all without extended thinking.
What the authors say about limits: scores focus on non-thinking agentic and software benchmarks; general chat, long-horizon autonomy and safety evaluation are not detailed; 1T total parameters create deployment barriers; training recipe and data are only partly open.
What it does not claim: not a win over closed models on every task; not the same lead under extended thinking; not consumer-hardware deployability because only 32B are active.

title.zh: Kimi K3.1 Pro：智能前沿，更进一步
title.en: Kimi K3.1 Pro: A Step Further at the Intelligence Frontier

evidence.quote: Kimi K3.1 Pro 在代码、3D 创作、金融研究和其他长程 Agent 能力上的提升尤为显著。
我们同步推出高速版模型 Kimi K3.1 Pro Highspeed，同等智能，输出速度约 2~3 倍。
完整模型权重将于 11 月 4 日前发布。

notes.zh:
问题：K3.1 Pro 的规模、上下文与产品分工是什么，官方承诺了哪些可验证的事实。
证据位置：官方发布页写明 K3.1 Pro 是 K3.1 系列首个模型、3 万亿级参数、100 万上下文；同步推出 Highspeed 高速版，输出速度约 2–3 倍；完整权重承诺在 11 月 4 日前发布。
作者自陈局限：发布页没有给训练数据、算力、完整评测口径与失败案例；权重发布是承诺时点，是否兑现需另行核验；评测图表为厂商自述。
它没主张的：不是独立第三方评测第一；不是所有任务都适合 3T 规模；不是权重已经开放。
notes.en:
Problem: what are K3.1 Pro’s scale, context and product split, and which verifiable facts does the official release promise?
Where the evidence sits: the official announcement says K3.1 Pro is the first model in the K3.1 line, with 3T-class parameters and 1M context; a Highspeed variant is launched with roughly 2–3x output speed; full weights are promised by November 4.
What the authors say about limits: the page does not disclose training data, compute, full evaluation protocols or failure cases; the weight release is a promised date and must be verified separately; benchmark charts are vendor-reported.
What it does not claim: a first place in independent third-party evaluations; that every task benefits from 3T scale; that weights are already open.

specs.产品分工 / variants: K3.1 Pro / K3.1 Pro Highspeed（输出约 2–3 倍）
specs.证据位置 / evidence: 发布页首段与权重承诺段
specs.复现状态 / reproduction: 未复现（只读官方发布页）

title.zh: SAM：可提示的分割一切模型
title.en: Segment Anything

evidence.quote: over 1 billion masks on 11M licensed and privacy respecting images
It can miss fine structures, hallucinates small disconnected components at times, and does not produce boundaries as crisply as more computationally intensive methods
SAM’s overall performance is not real-time when using a heavy image encoder.

notes.zh:
问题：分割任务通常按语义/实例/全景分开训练，换任务就要换模型；能不能定义一个「给提示就出掩码」的通用任务，用一个模型加提示工程覆盖多种分割？
证据位置：任务、模型与数据分别在 §3–§5；数据引擎与 SA-1B 在 §4；零样本评测在 §6–§7（23 个分割数据集、边缘检测、候选框、实例分割、文本到掩码）；局限集中在 §8，结论紧随其后。
作者自陈局限：§8 列了六条——会漏细结构，偶尔幻觉出小的不连通部件，边界不如「放大再算」的方法锐利；给很多点时，专用交互式分割方法会更好；重编码器使整体并非实时（虽然提示解码是实时的）；文本到掩码只是探索性尝试，不够稳健；如何用简单提示实现语义与全景分割仍不清楚；在特定领域，专用工具会优于 SAM。
它没主张的：没有说 SAM 在所有分割任务上超过专用模型——§8 明确说专用交互式方法与领域工具会更好；没有说文本到掩码可用——原文称 exploratory and not entirely robust；也没有说「分割一切」字面成立——论文自己把任务限定为可提示分割，并承认语义/全景分割的提示设计未解决。
notes.en:
Problem: segmentation is usually split into semantic, instance and panoptic tasks with separate models; can a single “give a prompt, get a mask” task plus prompt engineering cover many segmentation settings?
Where the evidence sits: task, model and data in Sections 3-5; data engine and SA-1B in Section 4; zero-shot evaluation in Sections 6-7 (23 segmentation datasets, edge detection, object proposals, instance segmentation, text-to-mask); limitations in Section 8, immediately before the conclusion.
Stated limits: Section 8 lists six — SAM misses fine structures, occasionally hallucinates small disconnected components, and produces less crisp boundaries than methods that zoom in; dedicated interactive segmentation methods outperform it when many points are given; the heavy image encoder means overall performance is not real-time even though prompt decoding is; text-to-mask is exploratory and not robust; simple prompts for semantic and panoptic segmentation remain unclear; and domain-specific tools will beat SAM in their domains.
What it does not claim: it does not claim SAM beats specialised models on every segmentation task — Section 8 says dedicated interactive methods and domain tools do better; it does not claim text-to-mask is usable, calling it exploratory and not entirely robust; and it does not claim “segment anything” literally, framing the task as promptable segmentation and leaving semantic/panoptic prompting unresolved.

specs.证据位置 / evidence: §3–5 任务/模型/数据；§6–7 零样本评测；§8 局限；结论
specs.规模 / scale: SA-1B：1B+ 掩码、1,100 万张授权与隐私合规图像
specs.关键数字 / key numbers: 23 个分割数据集零样本评测；单前景点即可产出高质量掩码
specs.自陈局限 / stated limits: 漏细结构、幻觉小部件、边界不锐利、整体非实时、文本到掩码不稳（§8）

title.zh: Efficient Memory Management for Large Language Model Serving with PagedAttention
title.en: Efficient Memory Management for Large Language Model Serving with PagedAttention

evidence.quote: High throughput serving of large language models (LLMs) requires batching sufficiently many requests at a time.
Our evaluations show that vLLM improves the throughput of popular LLMs by 2-4× with the same level of latency compared to the state-of-the-art systems, such as FasterTransformer and Orca.
For another example, in serving DNNs that are not LLMs, an increase in memory efficiency may not result in any performance improvement since the performance is primarily compute-bound.

notes.zh:
问题：服务端要靠批处理提高吞吐，但 KV 缓存占的显存既大又碎片化，批大小上不去；能不能用分页思路管理 KV 缓存。
证据位置：摘要给出 2–4 倍吞吐结论，对比对象是 FasterTransformer 与 Orca；分场景数字在第 6 节。
作者自陈局限：没有独立 Limitations 章节，边界写在第 8 节 Discussion——这套优化不适用于所有 GPU 负载：训练时张量形状固定、显存可提前规划；非 LLM 的推理若本身是算力瓶颈，提高显存效率不会提速，引入分页反而可能因间接寻址与非连续块访问而变慢。第 7.1 节的微基准还显示注意力 kernel 延迟比高度优化的 FasterTransformer 高 20–26%。
它没主张的：论文没有说 2–4 倍是端到端普遍结论，也没有说分页在任何负载上都不亏；块大小存在权衡——太小用不满并行度、太大内部碎片增加且共享概率下降。
notes.en:
Problem: serving throughput depends on batching, but KV cache memory is large and fragmented, which caps batch size; can paged memory management be applied to the KV cache.
Where the evidence sits: the abstract gives the 2-4× throughput result against FasterTransformer and Orca; per-scenario numbers are in Section 6.
What the authors say about limits: no separate Limitations section; the boundaries are in Section 8 (Discussion) — the optimisation does not generally hold for every GPU workload. In DNN training tensor shapes are typically static so allocation can be optimised ahead of time; for non-LLM inference that is compute-bound, raising memory efficiency may not help at all, and adding paged indirection and non-contiguous blocks may instead degrade performance. The Section 7.1 microbenchmark also reports 20-26% higher attention kernel latency than the highly optimised FasterTransformer implementation.
What it does not claim: the paper does not present 2-4× as a universal end-to-end result, nor claim paging is free on any workload; block size is a tradeoff — too small underuses GPU parallelism, too large increases internal fragmentation and lowers the chance of sharing.

specs.证据位置 / evidence: 摘要；Section 6 分场景；Section 8 Discussion；7.1 微基准
specs.kernel 开销 / overhead: 注意力 kernel 延迟高 20–26%
specs.不适用场景 / not applicable: 静态形状训练、算力瓶颈的非 LLM 推理

title.zh: Fast Inference from Transformers via Speculative Decoding
title.en: Fast Inference from Transformers via Speculative Decoding

evidence.quote: We demonstrate it on T5-XXL and show a 2X-3X acceleration compared to the standard T5X implementation, with identical outputs.
We measure walltime improvements with a batch size of 1 on a single TPU-v4 for both argmax sampling (temp=0) and standard sampling (temp=1).
We observe speedups of 2.6X (temp=1) and 3.4X (temp=0) on the translation task and slightly lower speedups of 2.3X (temp=1) and 3.1X (temp=0) for the summarization task.

One limitation of speculative execution in general, and of speculative decoding in particular, is that latency is improved through increased concurrency at the cost of an increased number of arithmetic operations. Thus, our method is not helpful for configurations where additional computation resources are not available.

notes.zh:
问题：自回归解码是串行的——生成 K 个 token 就要串行跑 K 次大模型；能否不改架构、不重训、也不改变输出分布，就把解码加速。
证据位置：摘要给出 T5-XXL 对比标准 T5X 实现的 2X-3X 加速且输出不变；实测数字在 Section 4.1 Table 2——单张 TPU-v4、batch size 1，目标模型 T5-XXL（11B），近似模型为 T5-small/base/large，任务是 WMT EnDe 翻译与 CNNDM 摘要；局限写在 Section 6 Discussion。
作者自陈局限：原文写明 "latency is improved through increased concurrency at the cost of an increased number of arithmetic operations"，因此 "our method is not helpful for configurations where additional computation resources are not available"；另自陈 "We tested speculative decoding only in the text modality"，beam search 场景的分析 "we leave it for future work"（Appendix A.4）。
它没主张的：论文没有说总算术运算量会下降——拒绝猜测时计算被浪费、总运算量可能更高，加速前提是有闲置算力（如内存带宽是瓶颈）；2X-3X 是 batch size 1、单 TPU-v4、对比 T5X 这一特定实现的口径，不能直接外推到批处理服务或其他硬件；也没有在其他模态上给出结果。
notes.en:
Problem: autoregressive decoding is serial — decoding K tokens takes K serial runs of the large model; can it be accelerated without changing the architecture, retraining, or the output distribution.
Where the evidence sits: the abstract reports 2X-3X acceleration on T5-XXL vs the standard T5X implementation with identical outputs; the measurements are in Section 4.1, Table 2 — a single TPU-v4, batch size 1, T5-XXL (11B) as target with T5-small/base/large as approximation models, on WMT EnDe translation and CNNDM summarization; the limits are in Section 6, Discussion.
What the authors say about limits: the paper states "latency is improved through increased concurrency at the cost of an increased number of arithmetic operations", hence "our method is not helpful for configurations where additional computation resources are not available"; it also notes "We tested speculative decoding only in the text modality", and the beam-search analysis is left to future work (Appendix A.4).
What it does not claim: the paper does not claim fewer total arithmetic operations — rejected guesses waste computation and total operations may rise, and the speed-up presupposes spare compute (e.g. memory bandwidth as the bottleneck); the 2X-3X figure is specific to batch size 1 on one TPU-v4 against the T5X implementation and does not automatically transfer to batched serving or other hardware; no results are claimed for other modalities.

specs.证据位置 / evidence: 摘要；Section 4.1 Table 2（单 TPU-v4、batch size 1）；Section 6 Discussion
specs.T5-XXL 加速 / speedup: 2X-3X（对比标准 T5X 实现，输出不变）

title.zh: Prefix-Tuning: Optimizing Continuous Prompts for Generation
title.en: Prefix-Tuning: Optimizing Continuous Prompts for Generation

evidence.quote: In this paper, we propose prefix-tuning, a lightweight alternative to fine-tuning for natural language generation tasks, which keeps language model parameters frozen, but optimizes a small continuous task-specific vector (called the prefix).

We find that by learning only 0.1% of the parameters, prefix-tuning obtains comparable performance in the full data setting, outperforms fine-tuning in low-data settings, and extrapolates better to examples with topics unseen during training.
With only 0.1% parameters, prefix-tuning underperforms full fine-tuning (35.05 vs. 37.25).

In concordance with this intuition, we observe that both prefix-tuning and adapter-tuning have significant performance gain in extrapolation settings (Section 6.4); however, the reason for such gain is an open question.

notes.zh:
问题：全量微调会改动全部参数，因此每个任务都要存一份完整模型副本；能不能冻住语言模型，只学一小段连续的任务专属向量（前缀），让后续 token 像注意虚拟 token 一样注意它。
证据位置：方法在 §4（含 §4.3 对前缀的重参数化）；主结果在 §6——表 1 是三个 table-to-text 数据集（E2E、WebNLG、DART），表 2 是 XSUM 摘要，低数据设定在 §6.3 与 Figure 3 右，外推在 §6.4；前缀长度等内在分析在 §7；开放问题在 §8 Discussion，结论在 §9。这篇没有独立的 Limitations 章节。
作者自陈局限：局限散在结果与讨论里，作者自己写明的有——§6.2 直接承认在 XSUM 上不如全量微调（0.1% 参数时 ROUGE-L 35.05 对 37.25，2% 时 36.05 对 37.25），并列出三条可能原因：XSUM 样本量平均多 4 倍、输入文章平均长 17 倍、摘要可能比 table-to-text 更复杂，这些是作者的解释而非验证过的结论；§6.3 说低数据下的优势随数据量增大而缩小（平均高 2.9 BLEU）；§7.1 说前缀超过阈值（摘要 200、table-to-text 10）后训练损失更低但测试表现略降，提示过拟合；§8.3 说外推收益的原因仍是开放问题，而参数效率更高的解释也只是「我们认为」。
它没主张的：论文只在 GPT-2 MEDIUM/LARGE 与 BART-LARGE 上验证（§5.3），§6.1 结尾说有潜力扩展到 GPT-3 这类更大的同架构模型，那是推测、没有实验；也没有说前缀微调在所有生成任务上都不输全量微调——摘要任务上就是输的；比较对象是 adapter 与只调顶部两层（FT-top2）等轻量基线，不涉及其他参数高效微调方法；§8.1、§8.2 关于百万用户个性化与跨用户批处理的说法是适用性讨论，没有对应的实验结果。
notes.en:
Problem: full fine-tuning modifies every parameter, so a complete model copy has to be stored per task; can the language model be frozen and only a small continuous task-specific vector (the prefix) be learned, with subsequent tokens attending to it as if it were virtual tokens.
Where the evidence sits: the method is in Section 4, including the reparametrisation of the prefix in 4.3; main results are in Section 6 — Table 1 covers three table-to-text datasets (E2E, WebNLG, DART), Table 2 covers XSUM summarisation, the low-data setting is in 6.3 and Figure 3 (right), and extrapolation in 6.4; intrinsic analysis such as prefix length is in Section 7; open problems are in Section 8 Discussion and the conclusion in Section 9. There is no separate Limitations section.
What the authors say about limits: the limits are spread across the results and discussion, and the ones the authors state themselves are — 6.2 plainly reports that prefix-tuning underperforms full fine-tuning on XSUM (ROUGE-L 35.05 versus 37.25 at 0.1% of parameters, and 36.05 versus 37.25 at 2%), and offers three possible reasons: XSUM has about 4x more examples on average, its input articles are about 17x longer, and summarisation may be more complex than table-to-text; these are the authors' explanations rather than verified conclusions. 6.3 says the low-data advantage narrows as the dataset grows (2.9 BLEU on average). 7.1 reports that beyond a threshold prefix length (200 for summarisation, 10 for table-to-text) training loss keeps dropping while test performance slightly degrades, suggesting overfitting. 8.3 says the reason for the extrapolation gain remains an open question, and the account of why prefix-tuning is more parameter-efficient is framed as what the authors think.
What it does not claim: the experiments cover only GPT-2 MEDIUM/LARGE and BART-LARGE (5.3), and the closing remark in 6.1 that it has the potential to scale to larger models of similar architecture such as GPT-3 is a suggestion without experiments; the paper does not claim prefix-tuning matches full fine-tuning on every generation task — it loses on summarisation; the comparisons are against lightweight baselines such as adapters and tuning only the top two layers (FT-top2), not other parameter-efficient finetuning methods; and the personalisation and cross-user batching arguments in 8.1 and 8.2 are applicability discussion with no corresponding experimental results.

specs.局限位置 / limits: 无独立 Limitations 章节；散在 §6.2、§6.3、§7.1、§8.3

title.zh: Ling and Ring 2.6 Technical Report: Efficient and Instant Agentic Intelligence at Trillion-Parameter Scale
title.en: Ling and Ring 2.6 Technical Report: Efficient and Instant Agentic Intelligence at Trillion-Parameter Scale

evidence.quote: a hybrid linear attention design that integrates Lightning Attention with MLA
this model family scales from 104B to 1T parameters
KPop, a reinforcement learning framework designed to support stable training of Ring-2.6-1T on large-scale environment-grounded data
We open-source all checkpoints in the 2.6 family

notes.zh:
问题：万亿级智能体模型既要低延迟，又要深推理，还要能稳定训练与部署；从零训练成本过高，能不能在已有基座上做架构迁移与后训练。
证据位置：摘要把 Ling-2.6（即时响应、高 token 效率）与 Ring-2.6（深推理、复杂智能体工作流）放在一个 104B–1T 家族；用 Lightning Attention + MLA 的混合线性注意力降长上下文训练/解码成本；KPop 用异步调度组织 coding、搜索、工具与工作流执行；2.6 家族检查点全部开源。
作者自陈局限：技术报告以自评为主，没有独立复现；1T 规模部署门槛高；KPop 依赖大规模环境数据；低延迟/深推理的分配策略仍要按场景调。
它没主张的：不是 1T 模型能在普通硬件跑；不是 Ling 与 Ring 两个模式对所有任务都最优；不是开源权重就等于训练配方全开放。
notes.en:
Problem: trillion-scale agentic models need low latency, deep reasoning and stable training/serving; training from scratch is too costly, so can an existing base be upgraded through architectural migration and post-training.
Where the evidence sits: the abstract puts Ling-2.6 (instant responses, high token efficiency) and Ring-2.6 (deeper reasoning, complex agent workflows) in one 104B–1T family; a hybrid linear attention design integrates Lightning Attention with MLA to cut long-context training and decoding cost; KPop asynchronously schedules coding, search, tool use and workflow execution; all 2.6 checkpoints are open-sourced.
What the authors say about limits: the technical report is self-evaluated, with no independent reproduction; 1T deployment has a high barrier; KPop depends on large-scale environment data; the latency/reasoning split still needs per-scenario tuning.
What it does not claim: not that a 1T model runs on ordinary hardware; not that Ling and Ring modes are optimal for every task; not that open weights mean the full training recipe is open.

specs.架构 / architecture: Lightning Attention + MLA 混合线性注意力

title.zh: The Llama 3 Herd of Models
title.en: The Llama 3 Herd of Models

evidence.quote: Our largest model is a dense Transformer with 405B parameters and a context window of up to 128K tokens
delivers comparable quality to leading language models such as GPT-4 on a plethora of tasks
The resulting models are not yet being broadly released as they are still under development

notes.zh:
问题：一个开放权重的 405B 稠密模型，能不能在多语言、代码、推理和工具使用上接近头部闭源模型，同时把训练与安全评测过程讲清楚。
证据位置：摘要给出 405B 稠密 Transformer、128K 上下文，称在大量任务上与 GPT-4 质量相当；多模态实验只做到图像、视频、语音接入，结果尚未广泛发布。
作者自陈局限：安全测试不可能穷尽风险，非英语与对抗提示下仍可能生成有害内容；多模态模型仍在开发中，未广泛发布；论文的「可比」来自其评测集，不是独立第三方横评。
它没主张的：不是所有任务都超过 GPT-4；405B 不是可普遍复现的算力门槛；多模态能力不是已发布产品能力。
notes.en:
Problem: can an open-weight 405B dense model approach leading closed models on multilingual, coding, reasoning and tool use, while documenting training and safety evaluation.
Where the evidence sits: the abstract reports a 405B dense Transformer with a 128K context window and says it delivers comparable quality to models such as GPT-4 on many tasks; multimodal experiments add image, video and speech capabilities, but those models are not broadly released.
What the authors say about limits: safety testing cannot be exhaustive, and harmful content remains possible in non-English languages and under adversarial prompts; the multimodal models are still under development and not broadly released; “comparable” comes from their evaluation suite, not an independent head-to-head.
What it does not claim: not a win over GPT-4 on every task; 405B is not a reproducible compute baseline for most teams; the multimodal results are not shipped product capability.

specs.安全边界 / safety: 测试无法穷尽，非英语与对抗提示仍有风险
specs.复现状态 / reproduction: 未复现（只读摘要与局限节）

title.zh: Visual Instruction Tuning
title.en: Visual Instruction Tuning

evidence.quote: the first attempt to use language-only GPT-4 to generate multimodal language-image instruction-following data
connects a vision encoder and LLM for general-purpose visual and language understanding
yields a 85.1% relative score compared with GPT-4 on a synthetic multimodal instruction-following dataset

notes.zh:
问题：多模态指令跟随数据稀缺，能否用纯语言 GPT-4 生成图文指令数据，再训练端到端多模态模型。
证据位置：摘要称首次用 language-only GPT-4 生成多模态指令数据；LLaVA 连接视觉编码器与 LLM；在合成多模态指令集上相对 GPT-4 得 85.1%；ScienceQA 微调后 92.53%。
作者自陈局限：数据由 GPT-4 生成，继承其偏差；视觉编码器与 LLM 组合固定；评测以合成指令集与 ScienceQA 为主；真实场景鲁棒性未证明。
它没主张的：不是通用多模态助手；不是视觉理解全能；85.1% 不是全面超过 GPT-4。
notes.en:
Problem: multimodal instruction-following data is scarce; can language-only GPT-4 generate image-text instruction data to train an end-to-end multimodal model?
Where the evidence sits: the abstract claims the first attempt to use language-only GPT-4 for multimodal instruction data; LLaVA connects a vision encoder and an LLM; it reports 85.1% relative score versus GPT-4 on a synthetic multimodal instruction set and 92.53% on ScienceQA after fine-tuning.
What the authors say about limits: data is GPT-4-generated and inherits its biases; the vision encoder and LLM pairing is fixed; evaluation centres on a synthetic instruction set and ScienceQA; real-world robustness is not established.
What it does not claim: not a general multimodal assistant; not all of visual understanding; 85.1% is not beating GPT-4 across the board.

title.zh: LoRA Learns Less and Forgets Less
title.en: LoRA Learns Less and Forgets Less

evidence.quote: in the standard low-rank settings, LoRA substantially underperforms full finetuning
LoRA better maintains the base model's performance on tasks outside the target domain
full finetuning learns perturbations with a rank that is 10-100X greater than typical LoRA configurations

notes.zh:
问题：LoRA 省显存是共识，但它相对全参数微调到底少学了多少、又少忘了多少，缺少同条件下的系统对照。
证据位置：摘要在编程与数学两个目标域、约 10 万条指令微调与 20B token 持续预训练两种数据机制下比较；标准低秩设置里 LoRA 明显不如全参数微调，但域外保持更好，且全参数微调学到的扰动秩比典型 LoRA 高 10–100 倍。
作者自陈局限：只覆盖编程与数学两个域、两种数据机制；结论针对标准低秩配置，不覆盖所有 rank/目标模块组合；没有给出所有任务的统一最优配方。
它没主张的：不是 LoRA 一无是处；不是全参数微调一定更好；不是提高 rank 就能完全抹平差距。
notes.en:
Problem: LoRA saves memory, but how much less it learns and how much less it forgets than full fine-tuning lacked a controlled comparison.
Where the evidence sits: the abstract compares programming and mathematics, in instruction fine-tuning (about 100K prompt-response pairs) and continued pre-training (20B tokens); in standard low-rank settings LoRA substantially underperforms full fine-tuning, but better preserves out-of-domain performance, and full fine-tuning learns perturbations with 10–100× higher rank than typical LoRA.
What the authors say about limits: only two target domains and two data regimes; conclusions apply to standard low-rank configurations, not every rank or target-module combination; no universal best recipe across all tasks.
What it does not claim: not that LoRA is useless; not that full fine-tuning always wins; not that raising rank closes the gap entirely.

specs.数据机制 / regimes: 约 10 万条指令微调；20B token 持续预训练
specs.秩差距 / rank gap: 全参数微调扰动秩高 10–100 倍

title.zh: Transformers are SSMs: Generalized Models and Efficient Algorithms Through Structured State Space Duality
title.en: Transformers are SSMs: Generalized Models and Efficient Algorithms Through Structured State Space Duality

evidence.quote: Our state space duality (SSD) framework allows us to design a new architecture (Mamba-2)
whose core layer is an a refinement of Mamba's selective SSM that is 2-8X faster
while continuing to be competitive with Transformers on language modeling

notes.zh:
问题：Transformer 与 SSM 长期被当成两条路线，能不能用结构化半可分矩阵把二者写成同一个理论框架，并据此做出更快的层。
证据位置：摘要提出 state space duality（SSD），把 SSM 与注意力变体通过矩阵分解连起来；由此设计 Mamba-2，其核心层是 Mamba 选择性 SSM 的细化版，速度提升 2–8 倍，语言建模仍与 Transformer 竞争力相当。
作者自陈局限：摘要只给「相对 Mamba 快 2–8 倍、与 Transformer 竞争」的结论，没有给完整任务表、最大规模或训练成本；没有独立复现；ICML 2024 版本与预印本可能不同。
它没主张的：不是「Transformer 已死」；不是所有序列任务都更快；2–8 倍是核心层速度，不是端到端训练或推理全面加速。
notes.en:
Problem: Transformers and SSMs have been treated as separate routes; can structured semiseparable matrices put both in one theoretical framework and yield a faster layer.
Where the evidence sits: the abstract introduces state space duality (SSD), connecting SSMs and attention variants through matrix decompositions; it then designs Mamba-2, whose core layer refines Mamba’s selective SSM, is 2–8X faster and remains competitive with Transformers on language modeling.
What the authors say about limits: the abstract gives the 2–8X layer speedup and competitive language-modeling result, but no full task table, maximum scale or training cost; there is no independent reproduction; the ICML 2024 version may differ from the preprint.
What it does not claim: not “Transformers are dead”; not faster on every sequence task; the 2–8X figure is a core-layer speedup, not end-to-end training or inference acceleration.

specs.核心层速度 / layer speed: 相对 Mamba 选择性 SSM 快 2–8 倍
specs.语言建模 / language: 与 Transformer 竞争力相当（摘要口径）

title.zh: MiniMax-01: Scaling Foundation Models with Lightning Attention
title.en: MiniMax-01: Scaling Foundation Models with Lightning Attention

evidence.quote: 32 experts and 456 billion total parameters, of which 45.9 billion are activated for each token
context window of MiniMax-Text-01 can reach up to 1 million tokens during training and extrapolate to 4 million tokens during inference
20-32 times longer context window

notes.zh:
问题：标准注意力在百万级上下文上成本过高；线性注意力常在能力或工程效率上掉队，能不能把 lightning attention 与 MoE、并行策略结合，真正做到长上下文可训练、可推理。
证据位置：摘要给出 32 专家、456B 总参数、每 token 45.9B 激活；用 lightning attention + MoE，并配合作者优化的并行与计算通信重叠；训练上下文 1M token，推理外推到 4M；相对 GPT-4o/Claude 3.5 Sonnet 的上下文窗口长 20–32 倍，标准与自建基准表现相当。
作者自陈局限：技术报告的自评为主；4M 是外推，不是所有任务都在 4M 上验证；长上下文能力与具体并行/kernel 实现强绑定；没有独立复现与完整安全评估。
它没主张的：不是线性注意力全面替代标准注意力；不是 4M 上下文在所有任务都无损；不是 456B 总参数就能消费级部署。
notes.en:
Problem: standard attention is too expensive at million-token context, while linear attention often loses capability or engineering efficiency; can lightning attention be combined with MoE and parallel strategies to make long context trainable and servable.
Where the evidence sits: the abstract reports 32 experts, 456B total parameters and 45.9B activated per token; it combines lightning attention with MoE and optimised parallelism plus compute-communication overlap; training reaches 1M tokens and inference extrapolates to 4M; the context window is 20–32× longer than GPT-4o/Claude 3.5 Sonnet, with comparable standard and in-house benchmark results.
What the authors say about limits: the technical report is self-evaluated; 4M is extrapolation, not validated on every task; long-context ability is tied to specific parallelism and kernels; there is no independent reproduction or full safety evaluation.
What it does not claim: not that linear attention fully replaces standard attention; not that 4M context is lossless on every task; not that 456B total parameters are consumer-deployable.

specs.参数 / parameters: 456B 总参数，45.9B 激活，32 专家
specs.对比 / comparison: 比 GPT-4o / Claude 3.5 Sonnet 长 20–32 倍

title.zh: Retrofitting language models to operate over bytes（Byteification）
title.en: Retrofitting language models to operate over bytes (Byteification)

evidence.quote: we introduce a general method for creating byte-level large language models through byteification that approach the capabilities of subword-based systems
retrofitted an existing subword-level LLM to the byte level using less than 1% of a typical pretraining budget (49.1B tokens in total
The resulting models outperform earlier byte-level approaches and excel on character-level reasoning tasks
We use a two-stage conversion procedure to retrofit existing subword-based models into byte-level models with minimal extra training.

notes.zh:
问题：主流 LLM 先把文本切成子词，字符级信息被遮住；代码、生物序列这类「单个字符/字节有意义」的数据尤其吃亏。字节级模型能避开分词，但此前性能一直落后。
证据位置：摘要给出方法与 49.1B token（不到典型预训练预算 1%）的转换成本；正文「Tokenizer transfer and retrofitting」说明两阶段流程；结果段报告 Bolmo 7B/1B、Bwen 8B、Blama 8B 等转换模型在字符级推理上超过早期字节级方法，并给出实际推理速度。
作者自陈局限：49.1B token 虽不到 1%，绝对量仍大；方法依赖一个已有子词模型作为教师，换源模型要重做；字节级推理需要专门内核，通用框架的支持并不自动成立；论文没有覆盖所有任务类型。
它没主张的：不是从零训练字节级模型；不是说字节级在所有任务上超过子词模型；不是宣布 tokenizer 无用；不是给出任意模型都能低成本转换的保证。
notes.en:
Problem: mainstream LLMs split text into subwords first, hiding character-level information; code and biological sequences, where individual characters or bytes matter, suffer most. Byte-level models avoid tokenisation but had lagged in performance.
Where the evidence sits: the abstract gives the method and the 49.1B-token conversion cost (less than 1% of a typical pretraining budget); the “Tokenizer transfer and retrofitting” section describes the two-stage procedure; the results report Bolmo 7B/1B, Bwen 8B and Blama 8B and character-level reasoning gains over earlier byte-level approaches, plus practical inference speed.
What the authors say about limits: 49.1B tokens is under 1% but still large in absolute terms; the method needs an existing subword model as teacher, so changing the source means redoing it; byte-level inference needs dedicated kernels, and generic framework support is not automatic; the paper does not cover every task type.
What it does not claim: training a byte-level model from scratch; that byte-level models beat subword models on every task; that tokenisers are obsolete; or that any model can be converted cheaply.

specs.证据位置 / evidence: 摘要；Tokenizer transfer and retrofitting；结果段

title.zh: Accurate and Efficient Long-Term Memory for LLM Agents
title.en: Accurate and Efficient Long-Term Memory for LLM Agents

evidence.quote: entity-typed graph storage with semantic classification preserving relational structure across events, personas, and relationships
hash-accelerated dual-path retrieval replacing LLM-based classification with locality-sensitive hashing
achieves 89.35% accuracy on LoCoMo (+27.21 pp over the best baseline)
detects 66% of injected factual conflicts

notes.zh:
问题：智能体的长期记忆常用扁平向量库，丢掉事件、人物、关系之间的结构；用 LLM 做记忆分类又太慢，还会在无校验时积累矛盾。
证据位置：摘要提出 MOSAIC，用实体类型图存事件/人物/关系，保留多跳与时序结构；用局部敏感哈希替代 LLM 分类做双路检索；保存时主动比对邻居并处理冲突；LoCoMo 89.35%（比公开基线高 27.21 个百分点），HaluMem 抽取 F1 86.77/85.84，冲突检出 66%，平均检索延迟 0.58 秒/题。
作者自陈局限：评测集中在 LoCoMo、HaluMem 与一个临床指南冲突测试；图结构依赖实体/关系抽取质量；没有生产级并发、权限与隐私验证；不是端到端训练。
它没主张的：不是所有记忆都该图结构化；不是 89.35% 代表开放域对话；不是 0.58 秒就是所有部署的延迟。
notes.en:
Problem: agent long-term memory often uses flat vector stores that lose event, persona and relationship structure; LLM-based classification is slow, and without validation contradictions accumulate.
Where the evidence sits: MOSAIC stores typed entity graphs for events, personas and relationships, preserving multi-hop and temporal structure; locality-sensitive hashing replaces LLM classification for dual-path retrieval; save-time conflict detection compares neighbours and updates or deletes contradictions; it reaches 89.35% on LoCoMo (+27.21 pp over the best baseline), HaluMem extraction F1 86.77/85.84, detects 66% of injected conflicts and keeps average retrieval latency at 0.58 s per question.
What the authors say about limits: evaluation centres on LoCoMo, HaluMem and a clinical-guideline conflict test; graph quality depends on entity/relation extraction; production concurrency, permissions and privacy are not validated; it is not end-to-end trained.
What it does not claim: not that every memory should be graph-structured; not that 89.35% represents open-domain dialogue; not that 0.58 s is every deployment’s latency.

specs.记忆 / memory: 实体类型图 + 语义分类
specs.检索 / retrieval: 局部敏感哈希双路检索

title.zh: Muon is Scalable for LLM Training
title.en: Muon is Scalable for LLM Training

evidence.quote: Muon achieves \sim\!2\times computational efficiency compared to AdamW with compute optimal training
Moonlight, a 3B/16B-parameter Mixture-of-Expert (MoE) model trained with 5.7T tokens using Muon
open-source our distributed Muon implementation that is memory optimal and communication efficient

notes.zh:
问题：Muon 在小模型上表现好，但缺少大规模训练的可扩展性证据；直接放大时，权重衰减与逐参数更新尺度会让训练不稳。
证据位置：摘要给两个关键修正——加 weight decay、调整每参数更新尺度，使 Muon 在大规模训练上开箱可用；scaling law 实验显示相对 AdamW 约 2 倍计算效率；用 Muon 训练 3B/16B MoE Moonlight，5.7T token，推进 Pareto 前沿；开源分布式实现与检查点。
作者自陈局限：最大验证到 16B MoE；计算效率是比较 compute-optimal 训练，不是所有训练预算；优化器收益依赖模型形状与并行实现；没有覆盖所有架构与任务。
它没主张的：不是 Muon 无条件替代 AdamW；不是 2 倍效率等于所有训练都减半；不是 16B 的结论自动适用于万亿模型。
notes.en:
Problem: Muon works well at small scale but lacked evidence of large-scale scalability; naive scaling is unstable because of weight decay and per-parameter update scale.
Where the evidence sits: the abstract adds weight decay and adjusts the per-parameter update scale so Muon works out of the box at large scale; scaling-law experiments show about 2× computational efficiency versus AdamW; Moonlight, a 3B/16B MoE, is trained with Muon on 5.7T tokens and improves the Pareto frontier; the distributed implementation and checkpoints are open-sourced.
What the authors say about limits: validation goes to a 16B MoE; the efficiency comparison is compute-optimal training, not every budget; optimizer gains depend on model shape and parallelism; not every architecture or task is covered.
What it does not claim: not that Muon unconditionally replaces AdamW; not that 2× efficiency halves every training run; not that 16B results automatically hold at trillion scale.

title.zh: Native Sparse Attention: Hardware-Aligned and Natively Trainable Sparse Attention
title.en: Native Sparse Attention: Hardware-Aligned and Natively Trainable Sparse Attention

evidence.quote: dynamic hierarchical sparse strategy, combining coarse-grained token compression with fine-grained token selection
enable end-to-end training, reducing pretraining computation without sacrificing model performance
NSA achieves substantial speedups over Full Attention on 64k-length sequences across decoding, forward propagation, and backward propagation

notes.zh:
问题：长上下文的标准注意力成本随长度平方增长；稀疏注意力往往只在推理阶段可用，或速度提升被内存访问拖掉，能不能做成可端到端预训练的硬件友好稀疏注意力。
证据位置：摘要提出 NSA，用粗粒度 token 压缩加细粒度 token 选择的分层稀疏策略；算法与硬件对齐，支持端到端训练；在 64k 长度上，解码、前向、反向都相对 Full Attention 有明显加速；预训练模型在通用、长上下文与指令推理基准上保持或超过 Full Attention。
作者自陈局限：主要证据在 64k 长度；加速依赖具体硬件与 kernel 实现；评测以预训练模型为主，未覆盖所有下游与部署场景；没有独立复现。
它没主张的：不是无限长度都线性；不是所有 GPU 上都能拿到同样加速；不是稀疏化一定无损。
notes.en:
Problem: standard attention scales quadratically with context; sparse attention is often inference-only or loses its speedup to memory access, so can it be made hardware-aligned and natively trainable end to end.
Where the evidence sits: the abstract introduces NSA with a dynamic hierarchical sparse strategy combining coarse token compression and fine token selection; it is hardware-aligned and end-to-end trainable; at 64k length it substantially speeds up decoding, forward and backward passes versus full attention; pretrained models maintain or exceed full attention on general, long-context and instruction-reasoning benchmarks.
What the authors say about limits: main evidence is at 64k; speedups depend on specific hardware and kernel implementations; evaluation centres on pretrained models, not every downstream or deployment case; there is no independent reproduction.
What it does not claim: not linear for unlimited length; not the same speedup on every GPU; not that sparsification is always lossless.

specs.方法 / method: 粗粒度压缩 + 细粒度选择，端到端可训练
specs.加速 / speed: 解码、前向、反向均明显快于 Full Attention

title.zh: Omni-Diffusion: Unified Multimodal Understanding and Generation with Masked Discrete Diffusion
title.en: Omni-Diffusion: Unified Multimodal Understanding and Generation with Masked Discrete Diffusion

evidence.quote: the first any-to-any multimodal language model built entirely on mask-based discrete diffusion models, which unifies understanding and generation across text, speech, and images
our method outperforms or performs on par with existing multimodal systems that process two or more modalities

notes.zh:
问题：多模态大模型几乎都押在自回归骨架上，离散扩散作为统一理解与生成的替代路线仍缺一个完整的任意模态系统。
证据位置：摘要称 Omni-Diffusion 是首个完全基于掩码离散扩散的任意到任意多模态语言模型，统一文本、语音、图像的输入与输出；在多项基准上优于或持平已有多模态系统（含处理两种以上模态的系统）；论文被 ICML 2026 接收。
作者自陈局限：覆盖模态只有文本、语音、图像，没有视频、3D、动作；「首个」是作者主张，未见独立复核；基准持平不等于全场景更强；未报告生产部署与推理成本。
它没主张的：不是自回归的全面替代；不是视频/3D 模型；不是已证明更省算力；不是所有任务都更好。
notes.en:
Problem: multimodal LLMs overwhelmingly rely on an autoregressive backbone; discrete diffusion remains an alternative route for unified understanding and generation but lacks a complete any-to-any system.
Where the evidence sits: the abstract describes Omni-Diffusion as the first any-to-any multimodal language model built entirely on mask-based discrete diffusion, unifying text, speech and image inputs and outputs; it outperforms or matches existing multimodal systems, including systems that handle two or more modalities, on a set of benchmarks; the paper is accepted to ICML 2026.
What the authors say about limits: coverage is text, speech and images only, with no video, 3D or action; “first” is the authors’ claim and has not been independently checked; benchmark parity is not across-the-board superiority; production deployment and inference cost are not reported.
What it does not claim: a wholesale replacement for autoregression; a video or 3D model; proof of lower compute; better results on every task.

specs.方法 / method: 掩码离散扩散；统一多模态 token 联合分布
specs.目标 / target: 文本 / 语音 / 图像的任意到任意理解与生成
specs.证据位置 / evidence: 摘要；多模态基准；ICML 2026 接收说明

title.zh: ORPO: Monolithic Preference Optimization without Reference Model
title.en: ORPO: Monolithic Preference Optimization without Reference Model

evidence.quote: a straightforward and innovative reference model-free monolithic odds ratio preference optimization algorithm, ORPO
eliminating the necessity for an additional preference alignment phase
fine-tuning Phi-2 (2.7B), Llama-2 (7B), and Mistral (7B) with ORPO on the UltraFeedback alone

notes.zh:
问题：常规偏好对齐要先把 SFT 与偏好优化分成两阶段，还要一个参考模型；能不能在 SFT 里直接加一个 odds ratio 惩罚，把对齐合并成一步。
证据位置：摘要提出无参考模型的 ORPO，把偏好对齐并入 SFT，不需要额外的对齐阶段；在 125M–7B 上验证，Phi-2 2.7B、Llama-2 7B、Mistral 7B 仅用 UltraFeedback 微调，AlpacaEval 2.0 最高 12.20%、IFEval 66.19%、MT-Bench 7.32，并公开 Mistral-ORPO 检查点。
作者自陈局限：验证规模到 7B；偏好数据只有 UltraFeedback；评测集中在 AlpacaEval/IFEval/MT-Bench；没有覆盖更大模型、长对话与安全对齐。
它没主张的：不是所有模型都能省掉参考模型；不是 ORPO 一定优于 DPO/PPO；不是 7B 的胜率能外推到 70B。
notes.en:
Problem: conventional preference alignment separates SFT and preference optimisation and needs a reference model; can an odds-ratio penalty be folded into SFT and collapse alignment into one stage.
Where the evidence sits: the abstract proposes reference-model-free ORPO, merging preference alignment into SFT without an extra phase; it validates from 125M to 7B, and Phi-2 2.7B, Llama-2 7B and Mistral 7B fine-tuned on UltraFeedback alone reach up to 12.20% on AlpacaEval 2.0, 66.19% on IFEval and 7.32 on MT-Bench, with Mistral-ORPO checkpoints released.
What the authors say about limits: validation stops at 7B; preference data is UltraFeedback only; evaluation centres on AlpacaEval, IFEval and MT-Bench; larger models, long dialogue and safety alignment are not covered.
What it does not claim: not that every model can drop the reference model; not that ORPO always beats DPO/PPO; not that 7B win rates extrapolate to 70B.

title.zh: OSWorld: Benchmarking Multimodal Agents for Open-Ended Tasks in Real Computer Environments
title.en: OSWorld: Benchmarking Multimodal Agents for Open-Ended Tasks in Real Computer Environments

evidence.quote: a benchmark of 369 computer tasks involving real web and desktop apps in open domains, OS file I/O, and workflows spanning multiple applications
humans can accomplish over 72.36% of the tasks, the best model achieves only 12.24% success
primarily struggling with GUI grounding and operational knowledge

notes.zh:
问题：电脑操作智能体缺少统一、可执行评估的真实环境；已有基准要么不交互，要么只覆盖单一应用，测不出跨应用与开放域任务。
证据位置：摘要提出 OSWorld，支持 Ubuntu/Windows/macOS 的任务设置、执行评估与交互学习；369 个真实网页/桌面应用任务，覆盖文件 I/O 与跨应用工作流；人类完成率 72.36%，参评模型中最高只有 12.24%，主要卡在 GUI grounding 与操作知识。
作者自陈局限：这是基准与环境，不是智能体方案；任务集合与评分脚本固定，不能覆盖所有真实软件；模型分数受截图分辨率、工具接口与提示影响；没有报告长期自主学习。
它没主张的：不是模型已经能替代人操作电脑；不是 12.24% 就是所有电脑任务的上限；不是 369 个任务能代表全部软件生态。
notes.en:
Problem: computer-use agents lacked a unified, executable real-environment benchmark; existing suites either do not interact or cover a single app, missing cross-application and open-domain work.
Where the evidence sits: OSWorld supports task setup, execution-based evaluation and interactive learning on Ubuntu, Windows and macOS; it has 369 real web/desktop tasks covering file I/O and multi-app workflows; humans complete 72.36% while the best model reaches only 12.24%, mainly failing at GUI grounding and operational knowledge.
What the authors say about limits: this is a benchmark and environment, not an agent recipe; the task set and evaluation scripts are fixed and cannot cover every real application; scores depend on screenshot resolution, tool interface and prompting; long-term autonomous learning is not reported.
What it does not claim: not that models can replace humans at computer work; not that 12.24% is the ceiling for all computer tasks; not that 369 tasks represent the whole software ecosystem.

title.zh: Training language models to follow instructions with human feedback
title.en: Training language models to follow instructions with human feedback

evidence.quote: Making language models bigger does not inherently make them better at following a user’s intent.
Our models are neither fully aligned nor fully safe; they still generate toxic or biased outputs, make up facts, and generate sexual and violent content without explicit prompting.
In human evaluations on our prompt distribution, outputs from the 1.3B parameter InstructGPT model are preferred to outputs from the 175B GPT-3, despite having 100x fewer parameters.

notes.zh:
问题：让模型跟着用户意图走，而不只是把下一词预测得更准；做法是用人类偏好数据做监督微调再训奖励模型做强化学习。
证据位置：摘要给出 1.3B 胜过 175B 的偏好结论；局限集中在第 5.3 节 Limitations，对齐对象的讨论在第 5.2 节，未解决问题在第 5.4 节。
作者自陈局限：写了三层——标注者以英语为主、数据几乎全是英文指令，不能代表全部使用者；模型既不完全对齐也不完全安全，仍会编造事实、生成有毒或偏见内容；作者认为最大的局限是模型多数情况下会服从用户指令，即使这在现实世界可能造成伤害。他们还明确说并不主张研究者、雇来的标注者或 API 客户就是偏好的正确来源。
它没主张的：论文没有说对齐问题已被解决，也没有给出一个能同时满足所有人偏好的方案——作者原话是不可能训练出同时对齐所有人偏好、或让所有人都认可其取舍的系统。
notes.en:
Problem: make a model follow user intent rather than only predict the next token better, using human preference data for supervised fine-tuning followed by reward-model-driven reinforcement learning.
Where the evidence sits: the abstract gives the 1.3B-beats-175B preference result; the limits are concentrated in Section 5.3 (Limitations), the question of whose preferences count is in 5.2, and open questions in 5.4.
What the authors say about limits: three layers — labelers are primarily English-speaking and the data is almost entirely English instructions, so they are not representative of everyone affected; the models are neither fully aligned nor fully safe and still fabricate facts or produce toxic and biased content; and the stated greatest limitation is that the models follow the user’s instruction even when that could cause real-world harm. They also state plainly that they are not claiming researchers, hired labelers or API customers are the right source of preferences.
What it does not claim: the paper does not say alignment is solved, nor offer a scheme that satisfies everyone — the authors write that it is impossible to train a system aligned to everyone’s preferences at once, or where everyone would endorse the tradeoffs.

specs.证据位置 / evidence: 摘要；Section 5.3 Limitations；5.2 对齐对象；5.4 开放问题
specs.摘要口径 / headline: 1.3B 的输出被偏好于 175B GPT-3，参数量少 100 倍

title.zh: Parameter-Efficient Subspace Optimization for LLM Fine-Tuning
title.en: Parameter-Efficient Subspace Optimization for LLM Fine-Tuning

evidence.quote: we provide convergence guarantees stated in the full-parameter space for the induced update, addressing a key limitation of LoRA-style analyses that only track low-dimensional factors
Empirically, PESO-LoRA improves over strong PEFT baselines on standard fine-tuning benchmarks.

notes.zh:
问题：LoRA 式分析通常只跟踪低维因子，缺少全参数空间里的收敛保证；子空间方法为何有效、何时该探索新子空间，也缺统一解释。
证据位置：摘要提出 PESO 框架，把 LoRA 等现有方法纳入子空间优化的「探索—利用」视角；实例化出的 PESO-LoRA 对诱导更新给出全参数空间收敛保证，并在标准微调基准上优于强 PEFT 基线。
作者自陈局限：属优化理论论文（math.OC），摘要未给模型规模、绝对分数或逐任务表；实验是标准微调基准；收敛结论依赖其假设；未报告生产部署。
它没主张的：不是新的模型架构；不是对所有任务都更快；不是完整的大规模基准横扫；不是无需调参。
notes.en:
Problem: LoRA-style analyses usually track only low-dimensional factors and lack convergence guarantees in the full parameter space; there is also no unified account of why subspace methods work or when to explore a new subspace.
Where the evidence sits: the abstract introduces PESO, which places methods such as LoRA in an exploration–exploitation view of subspace optimization; the instantiated PESO-LoRA gives convergence guarantees in the full-parameter space for the induced update and improves over strong PEFT baselines on standard fine-tuning benchmarks.
What the authors say about limits: this is an optimization paper (math.OC); the abstract gives no model scale, absolute scores or per-task table; experiments are standard fine-tuning benchmarks; the convergence result depends on its assumptions; no production deployment is reported.
What it does not claim: a new model architecture; faster results on every task; a complete large-scale benchmark sweep; no tuning required.

specs.目标 / target: 全参数空间收敛保证 + 内存效率
specs.证据位置 / evidence: 摘要；收敛性与标准微调基准

title.zh: Qwen2.5-VL Technical Report
title.en: Qwen2.5-VL Technical Report

evidence.quote: dynamic resolution processing and absolute time encoding
videos of extended durations (up to hours) with second-level event localization
Qwen2.5-VL is available in three sizes
flagship Qwen2.5-VL-72B model matches state-of-the-art models like GPT-4o and Claude 3.5 Sonnet

notes.zh:
问题：视觉语言模型常把图片缩放到固定分辨率、视频按固定帧率采样，导致小字、表格、长视频事件定位失真；能不能原生长分辨率、原生长时序。
证据位置：摘要提出动态分辨率处理与绝对时间编码，支持不同尺寸图像与长达数小时视频，并做到秒级事件定位；从零训练原生动态分辨率 ViT 并加 Window Attention；提供三个尺寸，旗舰 72B 在文档/图表理解上对标 GPT-4o 与 Claude 3.5 Sonnet。
作者自陈局限：对标结论集中在文档与图表；72B 是旗舰，未说明小尺寸差距；视频评测与真实部署仍有距离；没有独立复现与完整安全评估。
它没主张的：不是所有视觉任务都超过 GPT-4o；不是小时级视频都能精准定位；不是三个尺寸性能相同。
notes.en:
Problem: vision-language models often resize images to a fixed resolution and sample video at a fixed rate, hurting small text, tables and event localisation; can resolution and time be native.
Where the evidence sits: the abstract introduces dynamic-resolution processing and absolute time encoding, supporting varied image sizes and videos up to hours with second-level event localisation; a native dynamic-resolution ViT is trained from scratch with Window Attention; three sizes are offered, and the 72B flagship matches GPT-4o and Claude 3.5 Sonnet on document and diagram understanding.
What the authors say about limits: the comparison focuses on documents and diagrams; 72B is the flagship and the gap at smaller sizes is not detailed; video evaluation is not the same as production deployment; no independent reproduction or full safety evaluation.
What it does not claim: not a win over GPT-4o on every vision task; not second-level localisation in every hour-long video; not identical performance across the three sizes.

specs.视觉 / vision: 原生动态分辨率 ViT + Window Attention
specs.视频 / video: 最长数小时，秒级事件定位

title.zh: Qwen3 Technical Report
title.en: Qwen3 Technical Report

evidence.quote: parameter scales ranging from 0.6 to 235 billion
integration of thinking mode (for complex, multi-step reasoning) and non-thinking mode (for rapid, context-driven responses) into a unified framework
expands multilingual support from 29 to 119 languages and dialects
all Qwen3 models are publicly accessible under Apache 2.0

notes.zh:
问题：推理模型与聊天模型通常是两套权重，用户要在「想得深」和「答得快」之间切换；能不能用一套模型、一个框架同时提供两种模式，并给推理预算。
证据位置：摘要给出 0.6B–235B 的稠密与 MoE 系列；把 thinking / non-thinking 两种模式统一，支持按查询或模板动态切换，并引入 thinking budget；多语言从 29 种扩到 119 种；全部模型以 Apache 2.0 开放。
作者自陈局限：摘要的 SOTA 说法来自自建评测；最大 235B，部署成本未展开；thinking budget 的收益依赖任务与提示；没有独立复现与完整安全评估。
它没主张的：不是所有任务都该开 thinking；不是小模型在每项基准都追平大模型；不是 Apache 2.0 就等于无使用限制。
notes.en:
Problem: reasoning models and chat models are usually separate weights, forcing a trade-off between deep thinking and fast replies; can one model family provide both modes with a reasoning budget.
Where the evidence sits: the abstract covers dense and MoE models from 0.6B to 235B; it unifies thinking and non-thinking modes with dynamic switching by query or template and adds a thinking budget; multilingual support grows from 29 to 119 languages and dialects; all models are released under Apache 2.0.
What the authors say about limits: the SOTA claim comes from their own evaluation; the largest model is 235B and deployment cost is not detailed; thinking-budget gains depend on task and prompt; there is no independent reproduction or full safety evaluation.
What it does not claim: not that every task should enable thinking; not that small models match large ones on every benchmark; not that Apache 2.0 means no usage constraints.

specs.模式 / modes: thinking / non-thinking 统一框架 + thinking budget

title.zh: Qwen4-Max：阿里巴巴新一代旗舰模型
title.en: Qwen4-Max: Alibaba’s New Flagship Model

evidence.quote: 阿里巴巴集团正式发布 Qwen4-Max
新模型总参数达 2.4 万亿，具备原生视觉能力，支持长达 100 万个 token 的上下文窗口
每个 token 仅激活 710 亿个参数，较 Qwen3.8-Max 少25%
Qwen4 系列中规模较小的开放权重模型亦将于短期内向全球开发者发布。

notes.zh:
问题：Qwen4-Max 的规模、上下文、模态与开放权重路线是什么。
证据位置：阿里巴巴集团新闻稿写明 2.4 万亿总参、每 token 激活 710 亿（较 Qwen3.8-Max 少 25%）、原生视觉、100 万 token 上下文；同页确认 QwenCloud / API / QwenWork / QwenStudio 可用，并称 Qwen4 系列较小模型将陆续开放权重。
作者自陈局限：新闻稿没有给训练数据、算力、完整评测协议与失败案例；Code Arena、Work360 等结果均为厂商口径，未独立复现；「较小模型开放权重」是计划，不是已发布。
它没主张的：不做独立第三方评测的位次结论；不是所有任务都适合 2.4T 规模；不是 Qwen4 全系已开源。
notes.en:
Problem: what are Qwen4-Max’s scale, context, modalities and open-weight path?
Where the evidence sits: the Alibaba Group release states 2.4T total parameters, 71B active per token (25% fewer than Qwen3.8-Max), native vision and a 1M-token context; the same page confirms availability on QwenCloud / API / QwenWork / QwenStudio and says smaller Qwen4 models will be released as open weights.
What the authors say about limits: the release does not disclose training data, compute, full evaluation protocols or failure cases; Code Arena and Work360 results are vendor figures, not independently reproduced; "smaller open-weight models" is a plan, not a shipped release.
What it does not claim: a position in independent third-party evaluation; that every task benefits from 2.4T scale; that the entire Qwen4 line is already open-source.

specs.开放权重 / open weights: 较小 Qwen4 模型将陆续发布（计划）
specs.复现状态 / reproduction: 未复现（只读官方新闻稿）

title.zh: CLIP：用自然语言监督学习可迁移的视觉模型
title.en: Learning Transferable Visual Models From Natural Language Supervision

evidence.quote: we match the accuracy of the original ResNet-50 on ImageNet zero-shot without needing to use any of the 1.28 million training examples it was trained on
we estimate around a 1000x increase in compute is required for zero-shot CLIP to reach overall state-of-the-art performance. This is infeasible to train with current hardware.
CLIP only achieves 88% accuracy on the handwritten digits of MNIST. An embarrassingly simple baseline of logistic regression on raw pixels outperforms zero-shot CLIP.

notes.zh:
问题：视觉模型通常预测固定类别，换一个概念就要重新标数据；能不能直接用互联网图文对做对比学习，让自然语言成为分类器？
证据位置：方法在 §2（对比学习、zero-shot 分类器构造）；分析在 §3（细粒度、计数、OCR、分布偏移等）；局限集中在 §6，作者把散落在各节的问题汇总成一份清单。
作者自陈局限：§6 写得非常直白——zero-shot CLIP 平均只是接近「ResNet-50 特征 + 线性分类器」这一简单基线，要达到整体 SOTA 估计还需要约 1000 倍算力，当前硬件不可行；在细粒度分类（车型、花种、飞机型号）、计数、以及训练分布外的新任务上很弱，MNIST 手写数字只有 88%，不如原始像素上的逻辑回归；只能从给定分类器里的概念中选，不能像 caption 模型那样生成新描述；没有解决数据效率问题；开发过程中反复在完整验证集上调参，不符合真正 zero-shot 的设定；评测集是「有点随意拼出来的 27 个数据集」，与 CLIP 能力共同演化；训练数据未筛选，会学到社会偏见。
它没主张的：没有说 zero-shot 已经全面超过监督模型——原文说「often competitive」；没有说 CLIP 能处理所有视觉概念——§6 明确说很多任务接近随机；也没有说 4 亿图文对是数据效率的解法——作者反而说它只是用规模换监督。
notes.en:
Problem: vision models usually predict a fixed label set and need new labels for every new concept; can internet image-text pairs be used for contrastive pretraining so natural language itself becomes the classifier?
Where the evidence sits: approach in Section 2 (contrastive pretraining and zero-shot classifier construction); analysis in Section 3 (fine-grained, counting, OCR, distribution shift); limitations are collected in Section 6.
Stated limits: Section 6 is unusually direct — zero-shot CLIP is on average only competitive with a linear classifier on ResNet-50 features; reaching overall state of the art is estimated to need about 1000x more compute, infeasible on current hardware; it is weak on fine-grained classification (car models, flower species, aircraft variants), counting, and novel out-of-distribution tasks, scoring only 88% on MNIST handwritten digits, below logistic regression on raw pixels; it can only choose among concepts in a given classifier, unlike a caption model that can generate novel descriptions; it does not solve data efficiency; development repeatedly queried full validation sets, which is unrealistic for true zero-shot; the 27-dataset evaluation collection was somewhat haphazardly assembled and co-adapted with CLIP; and unfiltered training pairs teach social biases.
What it does not claim: it does not claim zero-shot beats supervised models across the board — the paper says “often competitive”; it does not claim CLIP handles all visual concepts — Section 6 says many tasks are near chance; and it does not claim 400M pairs solve data efficiency, arguing instead that CLIP trades scale for supervision.

specs.证据位置 / evidence: §2 方法；§3 分析；§6 Limitations（汇总清单）
specs.规模 / scale: 4 亿（image, text）对；30+ 个视觉数据集
specs.关键数字 / key numbers: ImageNet zero-shot 追平原始 ResNet-50（未用其 128 万训练样本）；MNIST 88%
specs.自陈局限 / stated limits: 需约 1000× 算力才到整体 SOTA；细粒度/计数/新任务弱；数据效率未解决；评测集共适应；社会偏见

title.zh: Whisper：用大规模弱监督做稳健语音识别
title.en: Robust Speech Recognition via Large-Scale Weak Supervision

evidence.quote: When scaled to 680,000 hours of multilingual and multitask supervision, the resulting models generalize well to standard benchmarks

we suspect fine-tuning Whisper models on a high-quality supervised dataset and/or using reinforcement learning to more directly optimize for decoding performance could help further reduce these errors
most languages have less than 1000 hours of training data

notes.zh:
问题：语音识别通常依赖大量高质量人工转写与领域内微调，换数据集就掉点；能不能用互联网上带噪的转写做弱监督，训练一个不微调也能跨数据集工作的模型？
证据位置：数据与任务设计在 §2，模型与训练在 §3，零样本评测在 §3.x；长音频解码启发式在 §4.5（Table 7）；局限集中在 §6 Limitations and Future Work，结论在 §7。
作者自陈局限：§6 列了五类——解码仍会重复循环、漏掉首尾词、甚至整段幻觉，§4.5 的启发式只是权宜；低资源语言数据少，很多语言不足 1,000 小时，性能差且提升路径是加数据；本文只研究了零样本，没有系统研究微调；Whisper 的稳健性有多少来自编码器、多少来自语言模型解码器仍不清楚；没有用无监督预训练或自训练等辅助目标。
它没主张的：没有说 Whisper 在所有语言上都接近人类——§6 明说很多语言仍很差；没有说零样本一定优于领域内微调——作者反而说高质量监督数据上微调可能更好；也没有说时间戳启发式解决了长音频问题——原文称其为 workaround，仍需更多研究。
notes.en:
Problem: speech recognition usually depends on large high-quality human transcripts and in-domain fine-tuning, and degrades when the dataset changes; can noisy internet transcripts provide weak supervision for a model that works across datasets without fine-tuning?
Where the evidence sits: data and task design in Section 2, model and training in Section 3, zero-shot evaluation in 3.x; long-form decoding heuristics in 4.5 (Table 7); limitations in Section 6 and conclusion in Section 7.
Stated limits: Section 6 lists five — decoding can loop, drop the first or last words, or hallucinate an entire transcript, with the 4.5 heuristics merely a workaround; low-resource languages have little data, many under 1,000 hours, and perform poorly; only zero-shot transfer was studied, not fine-tuning; how much robustness comes from the encoder versus the language-model decoder is unclear; and no unsupervised pretraining or auxiliary objectives were used.
What it does not claim: it does not claim Whisper approaches human accuracy in all languages — Section 6 says many remain poor; it does not claim zero-shot always beats in-domain fine-tuning, suggesting the opposite where high-quality supervised data exists; and it does not claim the timestamp heuristics solve long-form audio, calling them a workaround that needs more research.

specs.证据位置 / evidence: §2 数据；§3 模型与零样本评测；§4.5 长音频解码（Table 7）；§6 局限；§7 结论
specs.规模 / scale: 680,000 小时多语言、多任务弱监督
specs.关键数字 / key numbers: 零样本跨标准基准；多语言覆盖，低资源语言多不足 1,000 小时
specs.自陈局限 / stated limits: 重复/漏词/幻觉；低资源语言差；只研究零样本；编码器与解码器贡献不明（§6）

title.zh: Direct Preference Optimization: Your Language Model is Secretly a Reward Model
title.en: Direct Preference Optimization: Your Language Model is Secretly a Reward Model

evidence.quote: While large-scale unsupervised language models (LMs) learn broad world knowledge and some reasoning skills, achieving precise control of their behavior is difficult due to the completely unsupervised nature of their training.
Additionally, while we evaluate models up to 6B parameters, exploration of scaling DPO to state-of-the-art models orders of magnitude larger is an exciting direction for future work.
We note that we did not meaningfully tune DPO’s β hyperparameter, so these results may underestimate DPO’s potential.

notes.zh:
问题：RLHF 要训多个模型、还要在训练循环里从策略采样，流程复杂且成本高；能不能把偏好优化直接写成一个分类损失，跳过显式奖励模型与采样。
证据位置：方法推导与损失函数在正文前半；实验规模与超参说明在第 6 节。
作者自陈局限：这篇没有独立的 Limitations 章节，局限以「未来工作」的问句形式写在讨论里——只验证到 6B 参数，向更大规模扩展尚未做；GPT-4 自动评判的胜率会受提示词影响，如何稳定地引出高质量判断仍是开放问题；作者还主动说明 β 超参没有认真调，因此结果可能低估了方法潜力。
它没主张的：论文没有声称在更大规模上仍能追平 PPO 系方法，也没有说自动评判等同于人类判断；「更简单、更轻」是相对 RLHF 流程而言，不涉及最终模型能力上限。
notes.en:
Problem: RLHF trains several models and samples from the policy inside the training loop, which is complex and costly; can preference optimisation be written as a classification loss that skips the explicit reward model and the sampling.
Where the evidence sits: the derivation and loss are in the first half of the paper; the experimental scale and hyperparameter note are in Section 6.
What the authors say about limits: there is no separate Limitations section; the limits appear as future-work questions in the discussion — only models up to 6B parameters were evaluated, scaling to orders of magnitude larger is left open; GPT-4-computed win rates are affected by the prompt, so how to elicit reliable automated judgements is unresolved; and the authors volunteer that they did not meaningfully tune the β hyperparameter, so results may underestimate the method.
What it does not claim: the paper does not claim parity with PPO-based methods at larger scale, nor equate automated judgement with human judgement; "simpler and lighter" refers to the RLHF pipeline, not to a ceiling on model capability.

specs.证据位置 / evidence: 第 6 节（规模与 β 说明）；讨论部分（未来工作问句）

title.zh: LDM：在潜空间里做高分辨率图像合成
title.en: High-Resolution Image Synthesis with Latent Diffusion Models

evidence.quote: we apply them in the latent space of powerful pretrained autoencoders
Our latent diffusion models (LDMs) achieve new state-of-the-art scores for image inpainting and class-conditional image synthesis
their sequential sampling process is still slower than that of GANs

notes.zh:
问题：像素空间扩散效果好人尽皆知，但训练要几百 GPU 天、推理要反复过全分辨率网络；能不能先把图像压到潜空间，再在潜空间扩散，以此换效率？
证据位置：方法在 §3，包含感知压缩与语义压缩的拆分（§3.1）、潜空间扩散（§3.2）、cross-attention 条件机制（§3.3）；实验在 §4（无条件、布局/类别/文本条件、超分、inpainting）；局限在 §5 Limitations，结论在 §6。
作者自陈局限：§5 列了两条——第一，潜空间扩散仍是顺序采样，比 GAN 慢；第二，f=4 自编码器虽然画质损失很小，但重建能力会成为「像素级精细精度」任务的瓶颈，作者点名超分模型已受此限制。
它没主张的：没有说潜空间压缩无损——§5 明确说高精度场景可能不够；没有说 LDM 在所有任务上都超过像素扩散——摘要用「competitive」描述文本到图像、无条件生成与超分；也没有说 cross-attention 能理解任意条件——实验覆盖类别、文本、布局，但未证明开放域任意控制。
notes.en:
Problem: pixel-space diffusion is high quality but costs hundreds of GPU days to train and repeatedly runs a full-resolution network at inference; can images be compressed into a latent space and diffused there to buy efficiency?
Where the evidence sits: method in Section 3, splitting perceptual from semantic compression (3.1), latent diffusion (3.2), and cross-attention conditioning (3.3); experiments in Section 4 (unconditional, layout/class/text conditioning, super-resolution, inpainting); limitations in Section 5 and conclusion in Section 6.
Stated limits: Section 5 lists two — latent diffusion still samples sequentially and is slower than GANs; and although the f=4 autoencoder loses very little quality, its reconstruction can bottleneck tasks needing fine-grained pixel accuracy, with super-resolution called out as already limited.
What it does not claim: it does not claim latent compression is lossless — Section 5 says high-precision settings may not suffice; it does not claim LDMs beat pixel diffusion on every task — the abstract calls text-to-image, unconditional generation and super-resolution “competitive”; and it does not claim cross-attention understands arbitrary conditions, since experiments cover class, text and layout but not open-ended control.

specs.证据位置 / evidence: §3 方法（3.1–3.3）；§4 实验；§5 Limitations；§6 结论
specs.规模 / scale: 公开的 latent diffusion 与 autoencoder 权重；最高约 1024² 像素
specs.关键数字 / key numbers: inpainting 与 class-conditional 达新 SOTA；文本到图像、无条件、超分为有竞争力
specs.自陈局限 / stated limits: 顺序采样慢于 GAN；f=4 自编码器重建限制像素级精细任务（§5）

title.zh: RoFormer: Enhanced Transformer with Rotary Position Embedding
title.en: RoFormer: Enhanced Transformer with Rotary Position Embedding

evidence.quote: encodes the absolute position with a rotation matrix and meanwhile incorporates the explicit relative position dependency in self-attention
flexibility of sequence length, decaying inter-token dependency with increasing relative distances
consistently overcomes its alternatives

notes.zh:
问题：Transformer 的位置编码如何同时表达绝对位置与相对位置依赖。
证据位置：摘要给出用旋转矩阵编码绝对位置，并在 self-attention 中显式引入相对位置依赖；具备序列长度灵活性、随相对距离衰减的 token 依赖；在长文本分类基准上稳定优于替代方法。
作者自陈局限：实验以长文本分类为主；理论分析有限；超出训练长度仍需调参；不同实现的数值稳定性有差异。
它没主张的：不是长度外推的完整解法；不是所有模型都必须用 RoPE；不是训练越长越好。
notes.en:
Problem: how can Transformer positional encoding express both absolute position and relative-position dependency?
Where the evidence sits: the abstract encodes absolute position with a rotation matrix and injects explicit relative-position dependency into self-attention; it lists flexibility of sequence length and decaying inter-token dependency with distance; it reports consistent gains over alternatives on long-text classification benchmarks.
What the authors say about limits: experiments centre on long-text classification; theoretical analysis is limited; extending beyond training length still needs tuning; numerical stability varies across implementations.
What it does not claim: not a complete solution to length extrapolation; not mandatory for every model; not "longer training is always better".

specs.证据位置 / evidence: 摘要：旋转矩阵、相对依赖、长文本分类

title.zh: Stop When Memory Suffices: Evidence-Conditioned Progressive Execution for LLM Agents
title.en: Stop When Memory Suffices: Evidence-Conditioned Progressive Execution for LLM Agents

evidence.quote: A lightweight sufficiency router then predicts whether the context supports early termination
Router-Mem achieves 55.17\% and 38.77\% score
reducing average inference time by 27.3\% and 25.5\%

notes.zh:
问题：长期记忆系统要么压缩历史导致漏掉时序/因果依赖，要么每次都做深度研究导致延迟高；能不能先低成本检索，再判断证据够不够，够了就停。
证据位置：摘要提出 Router-Mem，先做共享低成本检索前缀，再用轻量 sufficiency router 预测当前证据是否足以提前终止，一次 token 决策；证据不足时复用检索命中扩展记忆块并深入分析；在 AMA-Bench、BEAM 上得 55.17%、38.77%，相对完整记忆执行平均推理时间降 27.3%、25.5%。
作者自陈局限：只验证两个记忆基准；router 训练依赖证据级监督与蒸馏；没有覆盖多轮工具调用、权限与生产并发；提前终止可能漏掉长尾证据。
它没主张的：不是所有问题都能早停；不是 27% 延迟下降等于同等准确率；不是两个基准代表全部长期记忆任务。
notes.en:
Problem: long-term memory systems either compress history and lose temporal/causal dependencies, or run deep research every time and pay high latency; can a cheap retrieval pass decide whether evidence is already sufficient.
Where the evidence sits: Router-Mem first runs a shared low-cost retrieval prefix, then a lightweight sufficiency router predicts whether the context supports early termination in a single-token decision; when evidence is insufficient it reuses retrieval hits to expand memory blocks and analyse deeper; it scores 55.17% and 38.77% on AMA-Bench and BEAM while cutting average inference time by 27.3% and 25.5% versus full memory execution.
What the authors say about limits: only two memory benchmarks; router training depends on evidence-level supervision and distillation; multi-turn tool use, permissions and production concurrency are not covered; early termination can miss long-tail evidence.
What it does not claim: not that every question can terminate early; not that 27% lower latency means equal accuracy; not that two benchmarks represent all long-term memory tasks.

specs.方法 / method: 低成本检索前缀 + sufficiency router 早停

title.zh: s1: Simple test-time scaling
title.en: s1: Simple test-time scaling

evidence.quote: curate a small dataset s1K of 1,000 questions paired with reasoning traces
budget forcing to control test-time compute by forcefully terminating the model's thinking process or lengthening it by appending "Wait" multiple times
exceeds o1-preview on competition math questions by up to 27% (MATH and AIME24)
from 50% to 57% on AIME24

notes.zh:
问题：测试时扩展被 o1 证明有效，但方法不公开；能不能用很小的数据、很简单的预算控制，复现出强推理并解释哪些因素起作用。
证据位置：摘要用难度、多样性、质量三条标准筛出 1,000 题的 s1K；提出 budget forcing，通过在模型想结束时强停或追加「Wait」来缩短/延长思考；Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct 微调后在 MATH 与 AIME24 上最多超 o1-preview 27%，继续扩展从 50% 到 57%。
作者自陈局限：评测集中在竞赛数学；s1K 只有 1,000 题，覆盖有限；budget forcing 依赖模型愿意继续生成，不是通用推理控制；32B 规模，未验证更大模型。
它没主张的：不是所有任务都能靠测试时算力提升；不是「Wait」提示万能；不是 27% 代表全面超过 o1-preview。
notes.en:
Problem: test-time scaling was demonstrated by o1 but its method was not public; can a tiny dataset and a simple budget control reproduce strong reasoning and show which factors matter.
Where the evidence sits: the abstract curates s1K, 1,000 questions selected for difficulty, diversity and quality; budget forcing either terminates the model’s thinking or appends “Wait” to lengthen it; Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct fine-tuned on s1K exceeds o1-preview by up to 27% on MATH and AIME24, and further scaling moves AIME24 from 50% to 57%.
What the authors say about limits: evaluation focuses on competition mathematics; s1K has only 1,000 questions; budget forcing depends on the model continuing to generate and is not general reasoning control; the model is 32B, with larger scales untested.
What it does not claim: not that every task improves with more test-time compute; not that appending “Wait” always works; not that 27% is an all-round win over o1-preview.

specs.方法 / method: budget forcing（强停 / 追加 Wait）

title.zh: Search-R1: Training LLMs to Reason and Leverage Search Engines with Reinforcement Learning
title.en: Search-R1: Training LLMs to Reason and Leverage Search Engines with Reinforcement Learning

evidence.quote: the LLM learns to autonomously generate (multiple) search queries during step-by-step reasoning with real-time retrieval
improves performance by 41% (Qwen2.5-7B) and 20% (Qwen2.5-3B) over various RAG baselines under the same setting
leveraging retrieved token masking for stable RL training and a simple outcome-based reward function

notes.zh:
问题：RAG 通常把检索结果一次性塞进提示，模型不会自己决定何时搜、搜什么、搜几次；能不能用 RL 让模型在逐步推理中自主发查询。
证据位置：摘要提出 Search-R1，在推理过程中自主生成多次搜索查询并实时检索；用 retrieved token masking 稳定 RL、只用结果奖励；七个问答数据集上相对多种 RAG 基线，Qwen2.5-7B 提升 41%、3B 提升 20%；代码与检查点开放。
作者自陈局限：只验证 3B/7B；任务集中在七组问答；检索环境与搜索工具固定；没有覆盖开放域研究、多跳网页浏览与生产延迟。
它没主张的：不是所有 RAG 都该改成 RL；不是 41% 是跨所有任务的统一增益；不是搜索次数越多越好。
notes.en:
Problem: RAG usually injects retrieved results into a prompt once, leaving the model unable to decide when to search, what to search and how often; can RL teach it to issue queries during step-by-step reasoning.
Where the evidence sits: Search-R1 autonomously generates multiple search queries with real-time retrieval during reasoning; retrieved-token masking stabilises RL and a simple outcome reward is used; across seven QA datasets it improves over several RAG baselines by 41% for Qwen2.5-7B and 20% for Qwen2.5-3B; code and checkpoints are open.
What the authors say about limits: only 3B/7B models; tasks are seven QA datasets; the retrieval environment and search tool are fixed; open-domain research, multi-hop browsing and production latency are not covered.
What it does not claim: not that every RAG system should switch to RL; not that 41% is a uniform gain across tasks; not that more searches are always better.

specs.方法 / method: 多轮搜索 + RL，retrieved token masking

title.zh: Self-Rewarding Language Models
title.en: Self-Rewarding Language Models

evidence.quote: the language model itself is used via LLM-as-a-Judge prompting to provide its own rewards during training
Fine-tuning Llama 2 70B on three iterations of our approach yields a model that outperforms many existing systems on the AlpacaEval 2.0 leaderboard
While there is much left still to explore

notes.zh:
问题：奖励模型常由人类偏好训练，能力受人类上限约束，且冻结后不能在训练中继续变强；能不能让语言模型自己当评审，在迭代 DPO 中同时提升指令遵循与自评质量。
证据位置：摘要说明用 LLM-as-a-Judge 给自身生成奖励，进行迭代 DPO；Llama 2 70B 迭代三次后在 AlpacaEval 2.0 上超过 Claude 2、Gemini Pro 与 GPT-4 0613。
作者自陈局限：作者明确说还有很多没探索；自评奖励可能继承评审偏差，迭代也可能放大偏差；只报 AlpacaEval 2.0 等有限评测，未覆盖全部任务与安全边界。
它没主张的：不是不需要人类反馈；不是所有模型都能自我无限提升；排行榜胜出不等同于真实用户偏好或安全对齐。
notes.en:
Problem: reward models are usually trained from human preferences, capped by human performance and frozen during LLM training; can a language model act as its own judge and improve both instruction following and self-judging through iterative DPO.
Where the evidence sits: the abstract uses LLM-as-a-Judge prompting to provide its own rewards during iterative DPO; Llama 2 70B trained for three iterations outperforms Claude 2, Gemini Pro and GPT-4 0613 on the AlpacaEval 2.0 leaderboard.
What the authors say about limits: they explicitly say much is left to explore; self-judging can inherit judge bias and iteration may amplify it; evaluation is limited to AlpacaEval 2.0 and related suites, not every task or safety boundary.
What it does not claim: not a replacement for human feedback; not unlimited self-improvement for every model; a leaderboard win is not the same as real user preference or safety alignment.

title.zh: SenseNova-U1: Unifying Multimodal Understanding and Generation with NEO-unify Architecture
title.en: SenseNova-U1: Unifying Multimodal Understanding and Generation with NEO-unify Architecture

evidence.quote: We launch two native unified variants, SenseNova-U1-8B-MoT and SenseNova-U1-A3B-MoT, built on dense (8B) and mixture-of-experts (30B-A3B) understanding baselines
preliminary evidence demonstrates that our models extend beyond perception and generation, performing strongly in vision-language-action (VLA) and world model (WM) scenarios

notes.zh:
问题：多数视觉语言模型把理解与生成当两件事，导致架构分裂、级联管线、表示空间对不齐，难以形成原生多模态能力。
