证据位置：摘要提出 NEO-unify 原生统一范式，并发布两个变体：8B 稠密与 30B-A3B 混合专家；作者称在文本理解、视觉语言感知、知识推理、智能体决策、空间智能上对标顶级纯理解 VLM，在文生图、复杂文字信息图、交错图文生成上保持语义与视觉一致性；另有 VLA 与世界模型的初步证据。
作者自陈局限：多为作者自评，未见独立复现；VLA 与世界模型只是 preliminary evidence；未给完整逐项分数与失败案例；未报告生产部署、许可与推理成本。
它没主张的：不是在所有专项模型之上；不是完整世界模型；不是开源发布（摘要未声明）；不是已解决多模态幻觉。
notes.en:
Problem: most vision-language models treat understanding and generation as separate problems, producing fragmented architectures, cascaded pipelines and misaligned representation spaces, which blocks native multimodal capability.
Where the evidence sits: the abstract proposes the NEO-unify native unified paradigm and releases two variants, an 8B dense model and a 30B-A3B mixture-of-experts model; the authors say they rival top-tier understanding-only VLMs on text understanding, vision-language perception, knowledge reasoning, agentic decision-making and spatial intelligence, while keeping semantic and visual consistency on text-to-image, text-rich infographics and interleaved vision-language generation; there is also preliminary evidence for VLA and world-model scenarios.
What the authors say about limits: most results are self-reported without independent reproduction; VLA and world-model evidence is explicitly preliminary; full per-task scores and failure cases are not given; production deployment, licence and inference cost are not reported.
What it does not claim: superiority over every specialist model; a complete world model; an open-source release (not stated in the abstract); a solution to multimodal hallucination.

specs.目标 / target: 统一多模态理解与生成，并延伸到 VLA / 世界模型
specs.证据位置 / evidence: 摘要；两个变体；自评基准与初步 VLA/WM 证据

title.zh: Strategist：让 agent 自己进化推理策略
title.en: Strategist: Evolving Reasoning with Agents

evidence.quote: We introduce Strategist, a meta-agent that evolves inference strategies across tasks.
On 30 benchmarks, Strategist beats the strongest baseline on 24 and matches its average accuracy (74.7% vs. 74.0%) at 39% lower inference cost.
Strategist is not Pareto-improving everywhere: on MedQA and AIME 2024 it is cheaper (0.44×, 0.77×) but 4–5 points less accurate
The test split, on which nothing is chosen, is the only unbiased estimate, and it is what every table reports.

notes.zh:
问题：agent 的推理流程（prompt、工具顺序、验证步骤）大多手工写，做完一个任务经验不沉淀，下个任务从零再来；模型冻结时，系统另一半能否自己变好？
证据位置：Strategist 把策略写成可执行 blueprint，候选策略在真实样本上跑、按结果改，所有策略连同测量卡进共享库；30 个 benchmark 上 24 胜、平均准确率 74.7% vs 对比基线 74.0%，推理成本低 39%；10 个 held-out 上不搜索也能接近基线，策略可迁移到 GPT-5 / Gemini-2.5。
作者自陈局限：不是处处 Pareto——MedQA / AIME 2024 更便宜但低 4–5 分；最终策略在 hidden split 上选，hidden 比 test 高 4.3 分而 test 只高 0.7，选择含运气；只测 30 个 benchmark 与 18 个基线；成本按 USD/token 计，换 provider 会变；没有独立复现。
它没主张的：不是所有任务都更便宜或更准；不是替代模型训练；不是自动发现就一定优于人写策略；不是跨所有模型/工具无成本迁移。
notes.en:
Problem: an agent's inference procedure — prompts, tool order, verification steps — is mostly hand-written, and experience from one task does not carry to the next; with the model frozen, can the other half of the system improve itself?
Where the evidence sits: Strategist writes strategies as executable blueprints, runs candidates on real samples and revises them from results, storing every strategy plus a measurement card in a shared library. On 30 benchmarks it wins 24, matches the strongest baseline's average accuracy (74.7% vs 74.0%) at 39% lower inference cost; on 10 held-out benchmarks retrieval without search stays close to the baseline, and strategies transfer to GPT-5 / Gemini-2.5.
What the authors say about limits: it is not Pareto-improving everywhere — on MedQA and AIME 2024 it is cheaper (0.44×, 0.77×) but 4–5 points less accurate; the final strategy is chosen on a hidden split, which is 4.3 points above baseline versus 0.7 on test, so selection includes luck; only 30 benchmarks and 18 baselines are tested; cost is measured in USD/tokens and changes with provider; no independent reproduction.
What it does not claim: that every task is cheaper or more accurate; a replacement for model training; that automated search always beats human-written strategies; cost-free transfer across all models and tools.

specs.迁移 / transfer: 10 个 held-out；GPT-5 / Gemini-2.5 可迁移
specs.机制 / mechanism: Strategy Blueprint + 共享库 + measurement card
specs.代价 / trade-off: MedQA / AIME 更便宜但低 4–5 分；hidden/test 选择有运气
specs.复现状态 / reproduction: 未复现（只读论文与 HTML 全文）

title.zh: RoFormer: Enhanced Transformer with Rotary Position Embedding
title.en: RoFormer: Enhanced Transformer with Rotary Position Embedding

evidence.quote: Specifically, the proposed RoPE encodes the absolute position with a rotation matrix and meanwhile incorporates the explicit relative position dependency in self-attention formulation.
As can be seen, RoFormer can significantly outperform BERT in three out of six datasets, and the improvements are considerable.
However, when increasing the maximum input text length to 1024, RoFormer outperforms WoBERT by an absolute improvement of 1.5%.

Despite the fact that we mathematically format the relative position relations as rotations under 2D sub-spaces, there lacks of thorough explanations on why it converges faster than baseline models that incorporates other position encoding strategies.

notes.zh:
问题：自注意力本身不带位置信息，已有的绝对与相对位置编码大多把位置向量加到词表示上，因此没法直接用在把注意力改写成线性形式的架构里；能不能让编码既带绝对位置、又在注意力内积中显式体现相对位置。
证据位置：方法在 §3.2（二维旋转推广到一般形式），长程衰减等性质在 §3.3 与 §3.4.3；实验在 §4，原文说明全部跑在两台各 4 张 V100 的云服务器上——WMT14 英德 BLEU 在表 1（Transformer-base 27.3、RoFormer 27.5），GLUE 六项在表 2，Performer 加 RoPE 的预训练损失曲线在 Figure 3 右图，中文长文本 CAIL2019-SCM 在表 5；局限有独立小节 §4.5.5 Limitations of the work。
作者自陈局限：§4.5.5 自己列了三条——把相对位置关系写成二维子空间里的旋转虽有数学形式，但没有充分解释为什么它比其他位置编码策略收敛更快；长程衰减性质已经证明、长文本上表现更好也观察到了，但作者说还没给出可信的解释；此外 RoFormer 建立在 Transformer 基础设施之上，预训练需要硬件资源。
它没主张的：论文没有说 RoPE 在所有下游任务上都优于 BERT——表 2 里 SST-2、QNLI、MNLI 三项 RoFormer 更低，正文自己写的口径是六项中的三项；表 5 的 1024 结果也不能读成「只在 512 上训练、直接外推到 1024」的证据，因为表 4 的分阶段预训练把最大序列长度提到过 1536；「能配线性自注意力」这一点在 §4.4 只用 Performer 的预训练损失曲线验证，没有给下游任务分数。
notes.en:
Problem: self-attention carries no position information by itself, and most existing absolute and relative encodings add a position vector to the token representation, so they cannot be used directly in architectures that rewrite attention in linear form; can an encoding carry absolute position while making relative position explicit inside the attention inner product.
Where the evidence sits: the method is in 3.2 (a 2D rotation generalised to the full form) and the long-term decay properties in 3.3 and 3.4.3; experiments are in Section 4, which states they all ran on two cloud servers with 4 V100 GPUs each — WMT14 English-German BLEU in Table 1 (Transformer-base 27.3, RoFormer 27.5), six GLUE tasks in Table 2, Performer-with-RoPE pre-training loss curves in Figure 3 (right), and Chinese long-text CAIL2019-SCM in Table 5; the limits have their own subsection, 4.5.5 Limitations of the work.
What the authors say about limits: 4.5.5 lists three — although relative position is formulated mathematically as rotations in 2D sub-spaces, there is no thorough explanation of why it converges faster than other position encoding strategies; the long-term decay property is proved and better long-text performance is observed, but the authors say they have not come up with a faithful explanation; and RoFormer is built on Transformer-based infrastructure, so pre-training requires hardware resources.
What it does not claim: the paper does not say RoPE beats BERT on every downstream task — in Table 2 RoFormer is lower on SST-2, QNLI and MNLI, and the text itself says three out of six datasets; the 1024 result in Table 5 is not evidence of train-at-512-then-extrapolate, because the staged pre-training in Table 4 raised the maximum sequence length to 1536; and compatibility with linear self-attention is supported in 4.4 only by Performer pre-training loss curves, with no downstream task scores.

specs.证据位置 / evidence: §3.2–§3.4（方法与性质）；表 1、表 2、表 5、Figure 3；§4.5.5 Limitations of the work
specs.GLUE 对比口径 / GLUE: 正文写六项中的三项优于 BERT（表 2）
specs.中文长文本 / long text: CAIL2019-SCM 输入长度 1024 时较 WoBERT 绝对提升 1.5%（§4.5.4 原文口径）
specs.局限位置 / limits: §4.5.5 Limitations of the work（独立小节）

title.zh: SWE-agent: Agent-Computer Interfaces Enable Automated Software Engineering
title.en: SWE-agent: Agent-Computer Interfaces Enable Automated Software Engineering

evidence.quote: SWE-agent's custom agent-computer interface (ACI) significantly enhances an agent's ability to create and edit code files, navigate entire repositories, and execute tests and other programs
achieving state-of-the-art performance on both with a pass@1 rate of 12.5% and 87.7%, respectively
we provide insight on how the design of the ACI can impact agents' behavior and performance

notes.zh:
问题：语言模型智能体做软件工程时，通用聊天界面并不适合读仓库、改多文件、跑测试；界面设计本身会不会决定成败。
证据位置：摘要提出 agent-computer interface（ACI），让智能体创建/编辑代码、浏览整个仓库、执行测试；在 SWE-bench 与 HumanEvalFix 上 pass@1 分别为 12.5% 和 87.7%，作者称超过此前非交互式 LM 的公开结果。
作者自陈局限：SWE-bench 的 12.5% 意味着大多数真实仓库问题仍未解决；评测集中在两个基准，不等于通用软件工程能力；ACI 依赖具体工具与仓库环境，换栈需要重新设计。
它没主张的：不是全自动替代工程师；不是在所有仓库/语言上都达到 87.7%；不是模型能力本身提升，界面与工具同样贡献结果。
notes.en:
Problem: when LM agents do software engineering, a chat interface is poorly suited to reading repositories, editing multiple files and running tests; does interface design itself determine success.
Where the evidence sits: the abstract introduces an agent-computer interface (ACI) that lets the agent create and edit code, navigate whole repositories and execute tests; pass@1 is 12.5% on SWE-bench and 87.7% on HumanEvalFix, which the authors call state of the art over prior non-interactive LMs.
What the authors say about limits: 12.5% on SWE-bench means most real repository issues remain unsolved; evaluation covers two benchmarks, not general software engineering; the ACI depends on specific tools and repository environments and must be redesigned for other stacks.
What it does not claim: not a replacement for engineers; not 87.7% on every repository or language; the gain is not model capability alone—interface and tools contribute.

title.zh: 腾讯 Hy4：正式版与开源路线
title.en: Tencent Hy4: Production Release and Open-Source Path

evidence.quote: Tencent today announced the release of Tencent Hy4, its latest-generation large language model, marking a significant leap in performance and capabilities that now ranks it among the world’s leading open-source AI models.
The new model also introduces visual understanding capabilities for the first time, alongside major improvements in instruction following, long-context comprehension and long-horizon agentic tasks
Tencent Hy plans to release model weights and system cards in the coming days

notes.zh:
问题：Hy4 正式版是什么定位，官方承诺了哪些可验证事实，参数量能不能直接引用。
证据位置：腾讯官方发布页写明 Hy4 于 2026-11-04 发布，首次引入视觉理解，并在指令跟随、长上下文理解与长程 agent 任务上有提升；同页称将随后发布模型权重与 system card。
作者自陈局限：发布页没有披露 Hy4 正式版的总参 / 激活数；「770B 总参 / 49B 激活」只出现在 Hy4 flash 发布页对 Hy4 Preview 的对照段，不能直接套到正式版；benchmark 图表与排名为厂商口径；权重与 system card 是承诺，需按后续发布核验。
它没主张的：不是独立第三方评测第一；不是所有任务都适合 Hy4 正式版；不是发布当天已开放全部权重。
notes.en:
Problem: how is production Hy4 positioned, which verifiable facts does the official release promise, and can its parameter count be quoted directly?
Where the evidence sits: Tencent’s release says Hy4 launched on 2026-11-04, adds visual understanding for the first time and improves instruction following, long-context comprehension and long-horizon agentic tasks; it also says model weights and system cards will follow.
What the authors say about limits: the release does not disclose production Hy4’s total / active parameter count; "770B total / 49B active" appears only as the Hy4 Preview comparison in the Hy4 flash release and must not be copied onto production Hy4; benchmark charts and rankings are vendor-reported; weights and system cards are promises to verify later.
What it does not claim: first place in independent third-party evaluation; that every task suits production Hy4; that all weights were open on launch day.

specs.规模 / scale: 正式版参数量未在该页披露
specs.能力重点 / focus: 指令跟随、长上下文、长程 agent
specs.权重 / weights: 官方称随后发布权重与 system card
specs.复现状态 / reproduction: 未复现（只读官方发布页）

title.zh: 用超时级联降低 coding agent 推理成本
title.en: Reducing Inference Cost of Coding Agents with Timeout Cascades

evidence.quote: We evaluate 36 popular large and small open-weight models released since 2024 on a software engineering benchmark, and find that recent small models are closing the accuracy gap compared to their large counterparts.

by utilizing a hybrid inference strategy that tries a small model first and escalates to a large one only when needed, we can achieve up to 33% reduction in total GPU-hour costs and 16.4% on all tasks from SWE-bench Verified, without sacrificing accuracy.
Our conclusions are constrained by single-run evaluations, one primary model pair, and one benchmark.
The cascade reduces GPU-hour cost and preserves resolve rate, but it does so by spending additional sequential time on tasks that eventually fall back.

notes.zh:
问题：coding agent 很吃 GPU 小时，小模型便宜但怕不稳；能不能先用小模型、失败再升级大模型，在不掉解决率的前提下省钱？
证据位置：论文在 SWE-bench Verified 上评 36 个 2024 年后开放权重模型，发现小模型在 easy/medium 上已接近大模型，差距集中在 hard；用 GLM-4.7-Flash 先跑、超时后升级 GLM-4.7，按 120 分钟超时，easy 任务 GPU 小时从 821 降到 546（-33.5%），全部任务从 2,585 降到 2,160（-16.4%），解决率不掉；简单级联接近 oracle 路由。
作者自陈局限：单次运行、只测一对主模型、只测一个 benchmark；工作负载必须 easy/medium 占多数（SWE-bench Verified 91%），hard 为主时级联会退化；升级是冷重启，不继承小模型的中间状态；墙钟时间反而增加（41.6 分钟/任务 → 65.5 或 84.5 分钟），不适合交互式等结果。
它没主张的：不是所有 coding agent 都能省 33%；不是小模型可以替代大模型；不是级联一定优于学习型路由；不是延迟也会下降。
notes.en:
Problem: coding agents burn GPU-hours; small models are cheaper but riskier. Can a small-model-first cascade cut cost without losing resolve rate?
Where the evidence sits: the paper evaluates 36 open-weight models released since 2024 on SWE-bench Verified and finds recent small models close the gap on easy/medium tasks, with the gap concentrated on hard tasks. Using GLM-4.7-Flash first and escalating to GLM-4.7 after a timeout, at a 120-minute timeout, GPU-hours fall from 821 to 546 on easy tasks (-33.5%) and from 2,585 to 2,160 on all tasks (-16.4%) without sacrificing resolve rate; the simple cascade nearly matches an oracle-style router.
What the authors say about limits: single-run evaluations, one primary model pair and one benchmark; the workload must be dominated by easy/medium tasks (91% of SWE-bench Verified), and the cascade degrades when hard tasks dominate; escalation is a cold restart and does not inherit the small model's intermediate state; wall-clock time rises (41.6 min/task to 65.5 or 84.5 min), so it is unsuitable for interactive waiting.
What it does not claim: that every coding agent saves 33%; that small models replace large ones; that a cascade always beats a learned router; that latency also falls.

specs.评测 / benchmark: SWE-bench Verified（500 题；混合策略用 466 题完整轨迹）
specs.模型 / models: 36 个 2024 年后开放权重模型；主对 GLM-4.7-Flash → GLM-4.7
specs.成本 / cost: easy 任务 -33.5%；全部任务 -16.4% GPU-hours
specs.解决率 / resolve: 不牺牲整体解决率；简单级联接近 oracle 路由
specs.代价 / trade-off: 墙钟 41.6 → 65.5 / 84.5 分钟；适合异步任务
specs.证据位置 / evidence: 摘要；第 V–VI 节；结论
specs.复现状态 / reproduction: 未复现（只读论文与 HTML 全文）

title.zh: Titans: Learning to Memorize at Test Time
title.en: Titans: Learning to Memorize at Test Time

evidence.quote: a new neural long-term memory module that learns to memorize historical context
fast parallelizable training while maintaining a fast inference
scale to larger than 2M context window size with higher accuracy in needle-in-haystack tasks

notes.zh:
问题：循环模型把历史压进固定大小隐状态，注意力则保留完整上下文但成本平方增长；能不能加一个在测试时持续学习的长时记忆模块，让注意力专注当前上下文。
证据位置：摘要提出神经长时记忆模块，学习记住历史上下文，同时保持可并行训练与快速推理；把注意力视为短期记忆、神经记忆视为长期记忆，给出 Titans 三种变体；在语言建模、常识推理、基因组与时间序列上优于 Transformer 与近期线性循环模型，并扩展到 2M 以上上下文。
作者自陈局限：证据集中在若干基准与 2M 上下文；记忆模块会引入额外训练/推理开销，摘要未展开；没有生产部署与独立复现；长上下文「更好」不等于所有任务更好。
它没主张的：不是无限上下文免费；不是替代注意力；不是所有长程任务都优于 Transformer。
notes.en:
Problem: recurrent models compress history into a fixed hidden state, while attention keeps the full context at quadratic cost; can a long-term memory module that learns at test time let attention focus on the current context.
Where the evidence sits: the abstract introduces a neural long-term memory module that learns to memorise historical context while keeping parallelisable training and fast inference; attention acts as short-term memory and the neural memory as long-term memory, with three Titans variants; experiments on language modelling, common-sense reasoning, genomics and time series beat Transformers and recent linear recurrent models, and scale beyond a 2M context window.
What the authors say about limits: evidence covers selected benchmarks and 2M context; the memory module adds training and inference overhead not detailed in the abstract; there is no production deployment or independent reproduction; “better at long context” is not “better on every task”.
What it does not claim: not free unlimited context; not a replacement for attention; not a win over Transformers on every long-range task.

specs.记忆 / memory: 神经长时记忆模块 + 注意力短期记忆
specs.任务 / tasks: 语言建模、常识推理、基因组、时间序列

title.zh: Toolformer: Language Models Can Teach Themselves to Use Tools
title.en: Toolformer: Language Models Can Teach Themselves to Use Tools

evidence.quote: LMs can teach themselves to use external tools via simple APIs
decide which APIs to call, when to call them, what arguments to pass, and how to best incorporate the results
requiring nothing more than a handful of demonstrations for each API

notes.zh:
问题：语言模型会写会读，却在算术、事实查询这类基础功能上不如小工具；能不能让模型自己学会调 API。
证据位置：摘要给出自监督训练目标：选哪个 API、何时调、传什么参数、如何把结果并入后续 token 预测；每个 API 只要少量示例；工具含计算器、问答、两个搜索引擎、翻译与日历。
作者自陈局限：工具集固定且少；自监督过滤依赖工具输出质量；实验模型与规模有限；没有讨论开放工具生态下的权限、安全与错误传播。
它没主张的：不是通用工具使用框架；不是不需要人工审核；不是所有 API 都能自学。
notes.en:
Problem: language models write and read well but underperform small tools on arithmetic and factual lookup; can they learn to call APIs themselves?
Where the evidence sits: the abstract describes a self-supervised objective that decides which API to call, when, with what arguments, and how to incorporate the result into future token prediction; a handful of demonstrations per API; tools include calculator, QA, two search engines, translation and calendar.
What the authors say about limits: the tool set is fixed and small; self-supervised filtering depends on tool output quality; model scale is limited; permissions, safety and error propagation in an open tool ecosystem are not discussed.
What it does not claim: not a general tool-use framework; not human-review-free; not every API can be self-taught.

specs.证据位置 / evidence: 摘要：自监督 API 调用与少量示例

title.zh: Llama 2：开放基础模型与对话微调模型
title.en: Llama 2: Open Foundation and Fine-Tuned Chat Models

evidence.quote: ranging in scale from 7 billion to 70 billion parameters
We also increased the size of the pretraining corpus by 40%, doubled the context length of the model, and adopted grouped-query attention

Llama 2-Chat is subject to the same well-recognized limitations of other LLMs, including a cessation of knowledge updates post-pretraining, potential for non-factual generation such as unqualified advice, and a propensity towards hallucinations.

notes.zh:
问题：开放权重模型能不能在有用性与安全性上接近闭源模型，同时把训练、微调与安全对齐的做法公开到可复用的程度？
证据位置：预训练在 §2（数据、40% 增量、双倍上下文、GQA）；微调在 §3（SFT、拒绝采样、PPO）；安全在 §4；观察与洞察在 §5，其中 §5.2 是 Limitations and Ethical Considerations；结论在 §7。
作者自陈局限：§5.2 列得很全——知识在预训练后停止更新；可能生成不实内容，例如不合格建议；有幻觉倾向；训练以英文为主，其他语言能力脆弱；可能生成有害、冒犯或偏见内容；安全微调有时过度保守，会出现过多拒答或堆砌安全说明；安全基准本身有局限，未必覆盖对抗输入、毒性内容与所有人群。摘要还说明 34B 模型因「没有足够时间做红队测试」而暂不发布。
它没主张的：没有说 Llama 2-Chat 在所有基准上超过闭源模型——原文是「may be a suitable substitute」，且基于自家人类评估；没有说安全对齐已经解决——§5.2 明说部分问题仍可能存在；也没有说多语言可用——原文说英文以外「fragile and should be used with caution」。
notes.en:
Problem: can an open-weight model approach closed models on helpfulness and safety while publishing pretraining, fine-tuning and safety alignment in a reusable way?
Where the evidence sits: pretraining in Section 2 (data, 40% more tokens, doubled context, GQA); fine-tuning in Section 3 (SFT, rejection sampling, PPO); safety in Section 4; observations in Section 5, with 5.2 covering limitations and ethical considerations; conclusion in Section 7.
Stated limits: 5.2 is thorough — knowledge stops updating after pretraining; the model can generate non-factual content such as unqualified advice; it is prone to hallucination; training is predominantly English and other languages are fragile; it may produce harmful, offensive or biased content; safety tuning sometimes over-corrects into excessive refusal or too much safety boilerplate; and safety benchmarks themselves may miss adversarial inputs, toxic content and some demographic groups. The abstract also says the 34B model was withheld for lack of time to red-team it sufficiently.
What it does not claim: it does not claim Llama 2-Chat beats closed models on all benchmarks — the paper says it “may be a suitable substitute” based on its own human evaluations; it does not claim safety alignment is solved — 5.2 says some issues may remain; and it does not claim multilingual readiness, calling non-English performance fragile and to be used with caution.

specs.证据位置 / evidence: §2 预训练；§3 微调；§4 安全；§5.2 局限与伦理；§7 结论
specs.规模 / scale: 7B、13B、70B 发布；34B 训练但未发布（红队时间不足）
specs.关键数字 / key numbers: 预训练语料 +40%；上下文长度翻倍；GQA
specs.自陈局限 / stated limits: 知识不更新、幻觉、英文为主、有害/偏见内容、安全过度保守（§5.2）

title.zh: Transfusion: Predict the Next Token and Diffuse Images with One Multi-Modal Model
title.en: Transfusion: Predict the Next Token and Diffuse Images with One Multi-Modal Model

evidence.quote: Transfusion combines the language modeling loss function (next token prediction) with diffusion to train a single transformer over mixed-modality sequences
We pretrain multiple Transfusion models up to 7B parameters from scratch on a mixture of text and image data
scaling our Transfusion recipe to 7B parameters and 2T multi-modal tokens produces a model that can generate images and text on a par with similar scale diffusion models and language models

notes.zh:
问题：文本模型用下一 token 预测，图像生成用扩散；能不能用一个 Transformer、一套混合模态序列，同时做两件事，而不是把图像离散成 token 再硬套语言模型。
证据位置：摘要把下一 token 预测损失与扩散结合，在文本和图像混合序列上训练单个 Transformer；从零训练到 7B，使用 2T 多模态 token，并通过模态专用编解码层把每张图压到 16 个 patch；作者称生成质量与同规模扩散模型、语言模型相当。
作者自陈局限：验证到 7B 参数、2T token；不是生产级多模态助手；图像生成只与同规模模型比较，不是与更大模型或所有任务比较；训练数据与配方未完全开放。
它没主张的：不是统一所有模态；不是图像生成全面超过专用扩散模型；不是 7B 就能替代更大规模系统。
notes.en:
Problem: text models predict the next token, image generation uses diffusion; can one transformer over mixed-modality sequences do both, instead of discretizing images and forcing them into a language model.
Where the evidence sits: the abstract combines next-token prediction with diffusion to train a single transformer over text and image sequences; models are trained from scratch up to 7B on 2T multimodal tokens, with modality-specific encoding/decoding layers compressing each image to 16 patches; the authors say generation is on par with similar-scale diffusion and language models.
What the authors say about limits: validation goes to 7B parameters and 2T tokens; it is not a production multimodal assistant; image generation is compared with similar-scale models, not larger systems or every task; the training data and full recipe are not fully open.
What it does not claim: not a unification of every modality; not a blanket win over dedicated diffusion models; not a replacement for larger systems at 7B.

specs.规模 / scale: 最高 7B 参数；2T 多模态 token

title.zh: UniM: A Unified Any-to-Any Interleaved Multimodal Benchmark
title.en: UniM: A Unified Any-to-Any Interleaved Multimodal Benchmark

evidence.quote: UniM contains 31K high-quality instances across 30 domains and 7 representative modalities: text, image, audio, video, document, code, and 3D
assesses models along three dimensions: Semantic Correctness & Generation Quality, Response Structure Integrity, and Interleaved Coherence

notes.zh:
问题：真实多模态应用要读任意组合、交错排列的输入，还要输出交错的多媒体内容；已有基准多停在单轮、双模态，测不到这种能力。
证据位置：摘要给出 UniM：31K 条高质量实例、30 个领域、7 种模态（文本、图像、音频、视频、文档、代码、3D）；评测分三维：语义正确性与生成质量、响应结构完整性、交错连贯性；另给出带可追踪推理的 UniMA 基线。
作者自陈局限：31K 是构建的数据集，不是持续更新的真实流量；7 模态仍缺触觉、动作等；三维评分如何自动判定、人工一致性如何，摘要未展开；UniMA 只是基线，不是能力上限。
它没主张的：不是新模型；不是排行榜；不是证明现有模型已解决任意到任意；不是评测全部多模态任务。
notes.en:
Problem: real multimodal applications must read arbitrarily combined, interleaved inputs and produce interleaved multimedia outputs; existing benchmarks mostly stop at single-turn, bimodal settings and cannot measure this.
Where the evidence sits: the abstract presents UniM with 31K high-quality instances across 30 domains and seven modalities (text, image, audio, video, document, code and 3D); it scores models on semantic correctness and generation quality, response-structure integrity, and interleaved coherence; it also provides UniMA, an agentic baseline with traceable reasoning.
What the authors say about limits: 31K is a constructed dataset, not continuously refreshed real traffic; seven modalities still omit touch, action and others; how the three dimensions are scored automatically and how consistent human judgements are is not detailed in the abstract; UniMA is a baseline, not a capability ceiling.
What it does not claim: a new model; a leaderboard; proof that current models have solved any-to-any; coverage of every multimodal task.

specs.模型规模 / scale: 31K 实例 / 30 领域 / 7 模态
specs.方法 / method: 统一任意到任意交错多模态基准 + UniMA 基线
specs.目标 / target: 测理解与生成交错的综合能力
specs.证据位置 / evidence: 摘要；数据集构成；三维评测

title.zh: Attention Is All You Need
title.en: Attention Is All You Need

evidence.quote: The dominant sequence transduction models are based on complex recurrent or convolutional neural networks that include an encoder and a decoder.

In the Transformer this is reduced to a constant number of operations, albeit at the cost of reduced effective resolution due to averaging attention-weighted positions, an effect we counteract with Multi-Head Attention as described in section 3.2.

We plan to extend the Transformer to problems involving input and output modalities other than text and to investigate local, restricted attention mechanisms to efficiently handle large inputs and outputs such as images, audio and video.

notes.zh:
问题：把序列转导模型从循环与卷积结构里解耦，只靠注意力建立输入输出之间的依赖，从而让训练可以并行。
证据位置：自注意力与其他层类型的每层复杂度、最少顺序操作数与最大路径长度比较在 Section 4「Why Self-Attention」的 Table 1。
作者自陈局限：结论一节没有写自身方法的局限，只给了两条未来工作——把模型扩到文本以外的模态、让生成更少串行。全文唯一接近代价的表述出现在 Section 2 Background，承认对注意力权重取平均会降低有效分辨率，并说明用多头注意力来抵消。
它没主张的：论文没有比较不同规模下的训练成本，也没有声称在机器翻译之外的任务上同样有效；「让生成更少串行」是研究目标，不是已完成的结果。
notes.en:
Problem: decouple sequence transduction from recurrent and convolutional structures and let attention alone carry the dependencies between input and output, so training can be parallelised.
Where the evidence sits: the per-layer complexity, minimum sequential operations and maximum path length comparison across layer types is Table 1 in Section 4, "Why Self-Attention".
What the authors say about limits: the conclusion states no limitation of the method itself and offers only two future-work items — extending the model to modalities other than text, and making generation less sequential. The one place in the paper that comes close to a cost statement is Section 2 (Background), which concedes that averaging attention-weighted positions reduces effective resolution and says multi-head attention counteracts it.
What it does not claim: the paper does not compare training cost across scales, nor claim effectiveness beyond machine translation; "making generation less sequential" is a research goal, not a delivered result.

specs.证据位置 / evidence: Section 4, Table 1（复杂度、顺序操作数、最大路径长度）
specs.局限位置 / limits: Section 7 结论：无局限声明，仅两条未来工作
specs.代价表述 / cost: Section 2 Background：注意力加权平均会降低有效分辨率

title.zh: Voyager: An Open-Ended Embodied Agent with Large Language Models
title.en: Voyager: An Open-Ended Embodied Agent with Large Language Models

evidence.quote: the first LLM-powered embodied lifelong learning agent in Minecraft
an automatic curriculum, an ever-growing skill library of executable code, and a new iterative prompting mechanism
It obtains 3.3x more unique items, travels 2.3x longer distances, and unlocks key tech tree milestones up to 15.3x faster

notes.zh:
问题：在开放世界 Minecraft 里，agent 能不能无人干预地持续探索、积累技能并完成新任务。
证据位置：摘要给出三组件：自动课程、可执行代码技能库、带环境反馈/执行错误/自验证的迭代提示；通过 GPT-4 黑盒调用，不微调模型；报告 3.3× 独特物品、2.3× 移动距离、15.3× 更快科技树里程碑。
作者自陈局限：单一 Minecraft 环境；依赖 GPT-4 API；技能库是可执行代码，权限与安全未讨论；开放世界长期泛化仍有限。
它没主张的：不是通用机器人 agent；不是真实世界部署；不是无需模型调用。
notes.en:
Problem: in open-world Minecraft, can an agent explore, accumulate skills and solve new tasks without human intervention?
Where the evidence sits: the abstract lists three components — automatic curriculum, an ever-growing skill library of executable code, and iterative prompting with environment feedback, execution errors and self-verification; it calls GPT-4 as a black box without fine-tuning; it reports 3.3x more unique items, 2.3x longer travel and up to 15.3x faster tech-tree milestones.
What the authors say about limits: single Minecraft environment; depends on GPT-4 API; the skill library is executable code with no discussion of permissions or safety; long-term open-world generalisation remains limited.
What it does not claim: not a general robot agent; not a real-world deployment; not free of model calls.

title.zh: Self-Consistency Improves Chain of Thought Reasoning in Language Models
title.en: Self-Consistency Improves Chain of Thought Reasoning in Language Models

evidence.quote: Chain-of-thought prompting combined with pre-trained large language models has achieved encouraging results on complex reasoning tasks.
One limitation of self-consistency is that it incurs more computation cost.

Our extensive empirical evaluation shows that self-consistency boosts the performance of chain-of-thought prompting with a striking margin on a range of popular arithmetic and commonsense reasoning benchmarks, including GSM8K (+17.9%), SVAMP (+11.0%), AQuA (+12.2%), StrategyQA (+6.4%) and ARC-challenge (+3.9%).

notes.zh:
问题：思维链只采样一条推理路径，这条路错了答案就错了；能不能采样多条再取一致答案。
证据位置：五项基准的绝对提升写在摘要；方法为先采样多条推理路径再对最终答案投票，见正文方法一节。
作者自陈局限：第 5 节只有两句——一是计算成本更高（要多次采样），这是方法自带的代价；二是观察到模型有时会生成错误甚至无意义的推理路径，如何让推理有据仍是后续工作。
它没主张的：论文没有说多数投票能纠正系统性错误——若模型在某类题上一致地错，投票只会强化错误；也没有说提升来自「推理更好」，测量的是最终答案准确率，不是推理过程正确性。作者在附录里对多模型集成的批评不适用于本方法，不要混引。
notes.en:
Problem: chain of thought samples a single reasoning path, so a wrong path yields a wrong answer; can several paths be sampled and the consistent answer taken.
Where the evidence sits: the absolute gains on five benchmarks are in the abstract; the method samples multiple reasoning paths and marginalises over final answers, described in the method section.
What the authors say about limits: Section 5 gives two — it incurs more computation cost, an inherent price of multiple sampling; and models sometimes generate incorrect or nonsensical reasoning paths, with grounding rationales left to future work.
What it does not claim: the paper does not claim majority voting corrects systematic error — if the model is consistently wrong on a class of problems, voting reinforces the wrong answer — nor that the gain comes from better reasoning, since what is measured is final-answer accuracy rather than the validity of the reasoning. The appendix criticism of multi-model ensembles does not apply to this method and should not be cited as its limitation.

specs.证据位置 / evidence: 摘要（五项绝对提升）；Section 5 结论与讨论
specs.代价 / cost: 多次采样，计算成本上升

title.zh: Chain-of-Thought Prompting Elicits Reasoning in Large Language Models
title.en: Chain-of-Thought Prompting Elicits Reasoning in Large Language Models

evidence.quote: We explore how generating a chain of thought—a series of intermediate reasoning steps—significantly improves the ability of large language models to perform complex reasoning.

As for limitations, we first qualify that although chain of thought emulates the thought processes of human reasoners, this does not answer whether the neural network is actually "reasoning," which we leave as an open question.

Third, there is no guarantee of correct reasoning paths, which can lead to both correct and incorrect answers; improving factual generations of language models is an open direction for future work (Rashkin et al. 2021; Ye and Durrett 2022; Wiegreffe et al. 2022, inter alia).

Finally, the emergence of chain-of-thought reasoning only at large model scales makes it costly to serve in real-world applications; further research could explore how to induce reasoning in smaller models.

notes.zh:
问题：复杂推理任务上直接给答案效果差，能不能让模型先写出中间推理步骤再给结论。
证据位置：规模涌现的结论在 Figure 4 与第 3.2 节，GSM8K 的具体数值在表 1、表 2（PaLM 540B 从 17.9 升到 56.9）。
作者自陈局限：第 6 节列了四条——思维链模仿了人类的思考过程，但这不回答神经网络是否真的在「推理」，作者把它留作开放问题；少样本场景手工加推理链的标注成本很低，但换到微调就可能高得不可行；没有任何机制保证推理路径正确，错误路径也能推出看似合理的答案；这种能力只在大规模模型上涌现，导致实际服务成本高。
它没主张的：论文没有说思维链让模型获得了可靠推理能力，也没有说小模型加提示就能复现；作者明确写了它对 10B 以下多数模型反而有害，所以「加一句 let’s think step by step 就变聪明」不是这篇的结论。
notes.en:
Problem: on complex reasoning tasks, answering directly works poorly; can the model be made to write intermediate steps before concluding.
Where the evidence sits: the scale-emergence result is Figure 4 and Section 3.2; the GSM8K numbers are Tables 1 and 2 (PaLM 540B from 17.9 to 56.9).
What the authors say about limits: Section 6 lists four — a chain of thought emulates human reasoning but does not answer whether the network is actually reasoning, which is left open; manually annotating chains is cheap in the few-shot setting but could be prohibitive for fine-tuning; there is no guarantee of correct reasoning paths, so wrong paths also produce plausible answers; and the ability emerges only at large scale, making real-world serving costly.
What it does not claim: the paper does not say chain of thought confers reliable reasoning, nor that small models can reproduce it with a prompt — the authors state it actually hurts most models under 10B parameters, so "just add let us think step by step" is not the finding here.

specs.涌现门槛 / emergence: 约 100B 参数以上；10B 以下多为负收益

title.zh: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models
title.en: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models

evidence.quote: While large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated impressive performance across tasks in language understanding and interactive decision making, their abilities for reasoning (e.g. chain-of-thought prompting) and acting (e.g. action plan generation) have primarily been studied as separate topics.

While interleaving reasoning, action and observation steps improves ReAct’s groundedness and trustworthiness, such a structural constraint also reduces its flexibility in formulating reasoning steps, leading to more reasoning error rate than CoT.

For ReAct, successfully retrieving informative knowledge via search is critical. Non-informative search, which counts for 23% of the error cases, derails the model reasoning and gives it a hard time to recover and reformulate thoughts.

Despite the simplicity of our method, complex tasks with large action spaces require more demonstrations to learn well, which unfortunately can easily go beyond the input length limit of in-context learning.

notes.zh:
问题：推理（思维链）与行动（动作规划）此前被分开研究，能不能让模型交替「想一步、做一步、看结果」再继续。
证据位置：摘要给出 ALFWorld 与 WebShop 分别高出模仿学习与强化学习 34% 与 10% 的绝对成功率；HotpotQA 27.4、FEVER 60.9 在表 1。
作者自陈局限：没有独立的 Limitations 章节，边界散在 §3.3 与 §6——交替结构提高了可追溯性，但也限制了推理自由度，推理错误率比纯思维链更高；检索到的信息是否有用是成败关键，无效检索占错误案例的 23%；大动作空间任务需要更多示例，很容易超出上下文长度上限；作者还指出所有提示方法都仍显著落后于领域专用的 SOTA，且离人类专家水平很远。
它没主张的：论文没有说 ReAct 在所有任务上都优于思维链——在 HotpotQA 上它比 CoT 略低（27.4 对 29.4），只在 FEVER 上更高；也没有说它能替代微调或达到人类水平。
notes.en:
Problem: reasoning (chain of thought) and acting (action planning) had been studied separately; can a model interleave thinking, acting and observing.
Where the evidence sits: the abstract gives absolute success-rate gains of 34% and 10% over imitation and reinforcement learning on ALFWorld and WebShop; HotpotQA 27.4 and FEVER 60.9 are in Table 1.
What the authors say about limits: no separate Limitations section; the boundaries are in 3.3 and 6 — the interleaved structure improves groundedness and trustworthiness but constrains reasoning flexibility, raising the reasoning error rate above plain chain of thought; whether retrieval returns useful knowledge is critical, and non-informative search accounts for 23% of error cases; tasks with large action spaces need more demonstrations, which easily exceed the in-context length limit; and all prompting methods remain well behind domain-specific state of the art and far from expert humans.
What it does not claim: the paper does not say ReAct beats chain of thought on every task — on HotpotQA it is slightly lower (27.4 versus 29.4) and only higher on FEVER — nor that it replaces fine-tuning or reaches human level.

specs.ALFWorld: 最佳 ReAct 平均成功率 71%（Act 45%、BUTLER 37%）

title.zh: Tree of Thoughts: Deliberate Problem Solving with Large Language Models
title.en: Tree of Thoughts: Deliberate Problem Solving with Large Language Models

evidence.quote: For instance, in Game of 24, while GPT-4 with chain-of-thought prompting only solved 4% of tasks, our method achieved a success rate of 74%.

ToT allows LMs to perform deliberate decision making by considering multiple different reasoning paths and self-evaluating choices to decide the next course of action, as well as looking ahead or backtracking when necessary to make global choices.

We scrape data from 4nums.com, which has 1,362 games that are sorted from easy to hard by human solving time, and use a subset of relatively hard games indexed 901-1,000 for testing. For each task, we consider the output as success if it is a valid equation that equals 24 and uses the input numbers each exactly once. We report the success rate across 100 games as the metric.
In general, cost and efficiency of ToT highly depend on the prompts and search algorithms used, and could require 5-100 times more generated tokens than CoT.

notes.zh:
问题：LM 推理仍是 token 级、从左到右的决策，在需要探索、策略前瞻或初始决策起关键作用的任务上会失效；能否让 LM 在以「思维」为中间步骤的树上做 deliberate 搜索——考虑多条推理路径、自评估选择、必要时前瞻与回溯。
证据位置：摘要给出 Game of 24 上 GPT-4 + CoT 仅解出 4% 而 ToT 达 74%；实验在 Section 4.1 Table 2——从 4nums.com 抓取的 1,362 局中取较难的第 901-1,000 局、以 100 局成功率为指标，GPT-4、温度 0.7（实验于 2023 年 5 月 5-16 日进行）；成本与局限在 Section 6 Discussion 与 Appendix B.3。
作者自陈局限：Section 6 写明这类 deliberate search "might not be necessary for many existing tasks that GPT-4 already excels at"，且作为初步工作只探索了三个相对简单的任务；Appendix B.3 写明 "could require 5-100 times more generated tokens than CoT"；工作只用现成 LM，微调被留作未来方向。
它没主张的：74% 是 100 局较难子集、BFS 每步保留 b=5 候选设置下的成功率，不是全部 1,362 局的成绩；论文没有证明 ToT 处处优于 CoT——Appendix B.1 在 GSM8K/StrategyQA 上只有小幅提升，B.2 中 GPT-3.5+ToT 在 Game of 24 仅 19%；作者也指出一般填字游戏可由专用 NLP 管线解决，本文并未主张取代它们，更没有任何训练层面的结论。
notes.en:
Problem: LM inference remains token-level, left-to-right decision making, which falls short on tasks requiring exploration, strategic lookahead, or where initial decisions play a pivotal role; can an LM instead search deliberately over a tree with thoughts as intermediate steps — considering multiple reasoning paths, self-evaluating choices, and looking ahead or backtracking when necessary.
Where the evidence sits: the abstract reports 74% success for ToT vs 4% for GPT-4 with chain-of-thought prompting on Game of 24; the experiment is in Section 4.1, Table 2 — the relatively hard games indexed 901-1,000 out of 1,362 scraped from 4nums.com, success rate over 100 games, GPT-4 at temperature 0.7 (experiments run May 5-16, 2023); cost and limits are in Section 6, Discussion, and Appendix B.3.
What the authors say about limits: Section 6 states that deliberate search "might not be necessary for many existing tasks that GPT-4 already excels at" and that, as an initial step, only three relatively simple tasks are explored; Appendix B.3 states ToT "could require 5-100 times more generated tokens than CoT"; the work uses an off-the-shelf LM, with fine-tuning left as a future direction.
What it does not claim: 74% is the success rate on the 100-game hard subset with BFS keeping b=5 candidates per step, not a result on all 1,362 games; the paper does not show ToT beats CoT everywhere — Appendix B.1 reports only slight gains on GSM8K/StrategyQA and Appendix B.2 reports GPT-3.5+ToT at 19% on Game of 24; the authors note general crosswords can be solved by specialized NLP pipelines, and no training-level claim is made.

specs.证据位置 / evidence: 摘要；Section 4.1 Table 2（Game of 24）；Appendix B.3 成本分析
specs.测试集 / test set: 4nums.com 共 1,362 局，取较难的第 901-1,000 局，以 100 局成功率为指标
specs.额外生成开销 / cost: 生成 token 可达 CoT 的 5-100 倍

title.zh: YaRN: Efficient Context Window Extension of Large Language Models
title.en: YaRN: Efficient Context Window Extension of Large Language Models

evidence.quote: requiring 10x less tokens and 2.5x less training steps than previous methods
LLaMA models can effectively utilize and extrapolate to context lengths much longer than their original pre-training would allow
extrapolate beyond the limited context of a fine-tuning dataset

notes.zh:
问题：RoPE 模型超出训练长度后失效，如何用更少 token 与训练步数扩展上下文窗口。
证据位置：摘要称比此前方法少 10× token、少 2.5× 训练步；LLaMA 可外推到远长于预训练的长度；在上下文扩展上超过此前 SOTA；可外推超过微调数据集的上下文。
作者自陈局限：以 LLaMA 系列为主；需要少量微调；超长上下文仍受注意力成本限制；未证明所有任务保真。
它没主张的：不是零成本无限上下文；不是不需要微调；不是所有模型通用。
notes.en:
Problem: RoPE models fail beyond their training length; how to extend the context window with fewer tokens and training steps?
Where the evidence sits: the abstract claims 10x fewer tokens and 2.5x fewer training steps than prior methods; LLaMA models extrapolate far beyond their original pretraining length; it surpasses prior SOTA on context extension and can extrapolate beyond the fine-tuning dataset context.
What the authors say about limits: mainly LLaMA-family experiments; requires light fine-tuning; long contexts still pay attention cost; fidelity on all tasks is not proven.
What it does not claim: not zero-cost infinite context; not fine-tuning-free; not universal across models.

specs.证据位置 / evidence: 摘要：10× token、2.5× 步数、LLaMA 外推
